name: 2026 PRE-SALE Ride Santa Barbara 100
description:
Ride Santa Barbara returns for its 15th year!

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

All courses start along the beach and follow the beautiful Santa Barbara beachfront before turning inland to experience all Santa Barbara has to offer. Cyclists will wind through some of the most exclusive neighborhoods in the country; experience the rolling foothills lined with citrus and avocado orchards and climb some of the most famous mountains in the country, all while experiencing some of the most beautiful views in southern California.

 

All cyclists will receive:

  • Official 2026 RideSB100 t-shirt
  • Official 2026 RideSB100 water bottle
  • Official RideSB100 musette bag with sponsor goodies
  • Fully supported aid stations
  • Mechanical support
  • Finish Line Festival with lots of food and beer
  • All Gibraltar Challenge finishers will receive a coin at the top of the hill.
  • Age group medals for Gibraltar Challenge
  • Option to buy event Jersey $105
  • And more!

All riders will receive an overall chip time and riders who participate in the Gibraltar Challenge will be ranked for the King and Queen of the Mountain (KOM/QOM) Jersey awards! 

 

RIDES*

 

100 mile

  • Over 9,400′ of climbing | Start Time: 7:00 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Tackle a challenging ride that begins at Chase Palm Park, rolls through Carpinteria, and continues into the scenic Lake Casitas region. Climb Toro Canyon and Ladera Lane before testing your legs on the Gibraltar Climb Challenge, a timed 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and over 2,500 ft of elevation gain. Descend, then join the 100KM Coastal Route along Cathedral Oaks through Isla Vista and past UCSB, finishing back at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100-mile/


100 KM + Climb 

  • Over 7,400 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for experienced cyclists only 
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s most stunning terrain, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Tackle the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and the steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then test your mettle on the Gibraltar Climb: a 6.1-mile ascent with an 8% grade and a 2,551 ft elevation gain. After summiting Gibraltar, descend via the technical Painted Cave route, continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community, and return to a well-earned finish at Chase Palm Park.
  • Includes a timed hill climb segment up the famous Gibraltar Road  – with a KOM/QOM jersey awarded to the 1st place winners in each age group!
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-climb/

 

100 KM Coastal Route 

  • 3,900 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 7:30 AM
  • Recommended for intermediate to experienced cyclists only
  • Covering 64 miles of Santa Barbara’s finest scenery, this route begins at Chase Palm Park and heads south along the coast to Carpinteria. Challenge yourself on the Toro Canyon Climb (5.3% grade) and steep Ladera Lane (10.9% grade), then descend toward the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. From there, ride west through Isla Vista, take in breathtaking coastal views at Goleta Beach, pass the University of California, Santa Barbara, and finish back at Chase Palm Park.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/100km-coastal/

 

34 miles 

  • Over 2,200 ft. of climbing | Start Time: 8:30 AM
  • Beginner to intermediate level cyclists 
  • Enjoy a stunning start along the coastline from Chase Palm Park before heading inland to San Ysidro Road. Tackle a gentle ascent on Mountain Drive (max 5.1% grade), then roll past the historic Old Mission Santa Barbara. Continue west along Riberia Drive through the serene Hope Ranch community and finish back at Chase Palm Park. Perfect for those seeking Santa Barbara’s natural charm with just the right amount of challenge.
  • For more information, go to ridesb100.com/34-mile/

*Event details and courses are subject to change. 

 

Charity

Ride to benefit MOVE Santa Barbara County! Help us raise needed donations and awareness for the great work they’re doing in Santa Barbara County. The mission of MOVE is to advocate for equitable county-wide infrastructure for walking, bicycling, and public transit and to empower and educate communities to choose active and sustainable forms of transportation. 

 

Refund Policy

All entry fees are NON-REFUNDABLE, no exceptions. Once we receive and accept your entry, you will not receive a refund if you cannot participate. You may do a one-time entry transfer to another event, person or year for $15.

For more information, visit our website ridesb100.com or e-mail our team at info@ridesb100.com.

 

Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter! 

Subscribe to our e-newsletter! 📧

RideSB100 offers four distinct courses to suit a range of cycling abilities – each course offering a world-class Santa Barbara cycling experience! 🚵🏻‍♂️

name: 2026 PRE-SALE Thrive San Diego Half Marathon & 5K
description:
The Kaiser Permanente Thrive Half Marathon & 5K returns for its 10th year!

We’re excited to THRIVE with you on Saturday, November 7, 2026! More than just a race, it’s an invitation for the entire San Diego community to “Thrive” together—staying active, eating healthy, living well, and giving back. All courses start and finish at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, offering fast, flat stretches with beautiful Mission Bay views and refreshing ocean breezes.

 
Half Marathon: 
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Experience 13.1 miles of scenic San Diego beauty on a loop course that starts on Ingraham Street, winds along Mission Bay, and finishes at Ski Beach. Enjoy fast, flat stretches, picturesque bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes as you chase your personal best.
  • Go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon/ for more information.

 

Half Marathon Relay:
  • Start Time: 7:15AM
  • Take on the Half Marathon Relay with a partner and split the challenge of 13.1 miles! Each runner will cover approximately 6.5 miles before handing off the "baton" to your teammate at Telecote Shores. This scenic route along Crown Point starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay, featuring fast, flat stretches, breathtaking bay views, and refreshing ocean breezes.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/halfmarathon-relay/.
 
5K:
  • Start Time: 7:30AM
  • The 5K is a scenic loop route along Crown Point that starts on Ingraham St and finishes at Ski Beach in Mission Bay.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/5k/.
 
Entry Includes:
  • Exclusive Performance Tech Long Sleeve (Half Marathon & Half Marathon Relay) 
  • Official Thrive Short Sleeve Tech Tee (5K)
  • Racer Bib
  • Finisher Medal Unique to Each Distance
  • Chip Race Timing
  • Live Finish Results and Rankings
  • Award Winner Prizes
  • Overall & Age Group Awards
  • Access to Thrive Expo
 

Virtual Runners:
  • For runners who can’t make it to San Diego but still want to participate and benefit Make-A-Wish San Diego! Complete your distance anytime during race week and post your results to the virtual leaderboard.
  • For more information go to thrivehalfmarathon.com/virtual-runners/

 

Charity:

Run to benefit Make-A-Wish® San Diego! Join us in granting wishes for children diagnosed with critical illnesses. Donate today to show your support for Make-A-Wish® San Diego on Race Day.

 

For more information on Make-A-Wish San Diego, visit thrivehalfmarathon.com/charity/.

name: 2026 Silver Strand Half Marathon, 10 Miler, 12K & 5K
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Picture this: A heart-pounding, flat-out run along the closed Silver Strand Highway 79, with the majestic Pacific Ocean on your right and the stunning San Diego Bay on your left. 🌊

But hold onto your running shoes because it's not just a race – it's a BLAST! 🎉 As you tackle the half marathon, 12K, or 10-mile courses, you'll groove to the rhythm of the Taku Drummers, jam to the hottest beats spun by a DJ, and soak in live music that'll have you moving to the groove. 🥁🎵

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

name: 20th Annual Freedom Run on the Ranch - July 4th 2026
description:
A Ladera Ranch tradition - The Freedom Run on the Ranch is happy to invite you to run in the kids Firecracker 1k or our 5k and 10k runs.  The event provides our community the ability to support local charities through the race registration proceeds and sponsorship opportunities.  We encourage all to enjoy this great opportunity to celebrate our national holiday and have a little fun while running the streets of your community.  We will  have several festivities to support the runners and non-participants at the event with a breakfast and sponsor vendor area during the morning event.  Please help us celebrate the 4th of July festivities and raise awareness and much needed support to the charities.  Remember price increases on June 22nd.  Also help support our charities by purchasing breakfast from participating local restaurants.  All proceeds benefit the charities.

Packet Pickup - TBD

6:00 am Race Registration opens

7:00 am - 10k run starts

8:30 am - 5k run starts

8:00 am - XclusiveTaqueria Moderna Pancake breakfast begins

9:45 am - Kids 1k run starts

11:00 am - Event ends

name: 2nd Annual Los Feliz 5K Run/Walk 10K and Toddler Dash
description:
The Los Feliz Running Club is very excited and proud to present the 1st Annual Los Feliz 5k Run/Walk and Blood Drive in support of the American Red Cross! The event will take place on Saturday June 1st, 2024 at 8:00AM at the Griffith Park Crystal Springs Drive 5K Loop. The event will be timed.

Concurrent with the event, the American Red Cross will be hosting a blood drive at the race location. Members of the Los Feliz Community are invited to either Run/Walk the event or donate blood.

Participants who run/walk the event and subsequently donate blood will be awarded the special Heart of Gold Medal and goodie bag with extra special giveaways!

Follow this link to register as a donor for the Blood Drive! 

https://www.redcrossblood.org/give.html/drive-results?zipSponsor=LFRC5K

name: 2nd Annual WARC 5K Turkey Trot
description:
Start your Thanksgiving morning with movement, community, and fun at the 2nd Annual WARC Turkey Trot 5K Run/Walk at Lodi Lake Park!

This family-friendly 5K welcomes runners and walkers of all ages and paces. Paid participants (ages 7+) receive a festive Turkey Trot T-shirt and finisher medal, while kids 6 & under can join for free. T-Shirts are only guaranteed if registered by November 17th. We will have extra, but will be on a first come first serve basis. Sizes will be limited.

The WARC Turkey Trot is all about celebrating movement, gratitude, and togetherness. There are no timing chips or awards — just a fun, feel-good morning surrounded by great people and positive energy. Every finisher is a winner!

Enjoy a scenic route, warm-up session, music, and post-run refreshments — the perfect way to kick off your holiday before the big feast!

Check-in: 8:00 AM

Warm-up: 8:45 AM

Run Start: 9:00 AM

Come for the miles, stay for the smiles — and let’s make this Thanksgiving morning one to remember!

name: 33rd Annual Brea 8K Classic presented by Brea Mall  - Race Starts at 7am!
description:
Join the Excitement at the Brea 8K Classic!


What started with just 68 runners has grown into one of Southern California’s most beloved community races—and this year, we’re going bigger than ever! Thousands of runners, walkers, volunteers, and supporters from across the country will come together for a day of fitness, fun, and purpose.

Why run with us?

A Scenic, USATF-Certified Course: Enjoy rolling hills and vibrant neighborhoods in beautiful Brea.
Unforgettable Energy: Live music, cheering crowds, and a post-race celebration featuring local food and drinks.
Make a Difference: Every step you take supports Brea Olinda High School’s award-winning music program—helping students access instruments, sheet music, and opportunities to perform and compete.


Your participation matters. This single event is the most impactful fundraiser for our city’s only comprehensive high school. By joining, you’re not just running—you’re investing in creativity, collaboration, and the cultural heartbeat of our community.

Ready to be part of something special?
Sign up today and experience the thrill of the Brea 8K Classic. Lace up, show up, and make an impact!

name: 36th Annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K
description:
The Lopers Club and the City of Loma Linda present the 36th annual Lopers Club Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K! The Holiday Classic is the Inland Empire’s longest running annual holiday running event and a local tradition for runners and walkers of all ages and abilities!

Location

The race Start/Finish will take place in front of the Loma Linda Fire Station located at 11325 Loma Linda Drive in Loma Linda. Park in any nearby lot except for the Veteran's Hospital.

Event information

This year’s event will take place on Sunday, December 7, 2025. The Half Marathon, 10K and 5K will run simultaneously. Start time is 7:00 am. The Half Marathon has a course limit of 4 hours which is allows for walkers who can maintain an 18 minute per mile average pace. There will be many walkers as well as runners in both the 5K, 10K and Half Marathon.

The Start/Finish Line will be located near the corner of Barton Road and Loma Linda Drive, in front of the Loma Linda Fire station.

Event features

The Holiday Classic Half Marathon, 10K,  and 5K run/walk, provides scenic mountain views with stimulating inclines on a course which winds through the lovely streets of Loma Linda. Beautiful, long-sleeved tech shirts will be provided for all participants who register prior to November 9, 2025. Participants registering after the cutoff will receive a shirt while supplies last, we might not have your size if you register in less than three weeks before the event. All finishers of both the Half Marathon, 10K and the 5K event will be awarded beautiful finishers' medals. Trophies will be awarded to the overall top male and female winner of each race. Division medals will be awarded to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place male and female finishers in each of 20 age divisions.

Bring the kids! The Holiday Classic includes a ¼ mile Elves Trot fun run for children ages 3-6. Every participating elf will receive an adorable Santa medal.

Post-race festivities

All participants of the Half Marathon, 10K and 5K will receive a free breakfast. There is a $3 charge for Elves Trot participants. Also free to all participants, a soothing, post-race mini-massage provided by gentle therapists from Precision in Movement.

Groups/teams

Create a team for your family, friends and coworkers to join. Each team participant will get a $5 discount for teams of between 5 and 14 participants. Each participant will get a $10 discount for teams of greater than 15 participants.

Bib pickup and registration

Pick up your shirt and bib Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm, at Running Center in Redlands (1430 Industrial Park Avenue).

Volunteer check-in

Volunteers can pick up their volunteer assignments and T-shirts Saturday, December 6, from 10 am to 3 pm, at Running Center in Redlands (1430 Industrial Park Avenue).

Holiday Toy Drive

Join the Loma Linda Fire Department and ABC7 in the 33nd annual Spark of Love Toy Drive--the largest community toy drive in the nation.

The fire department will be accepting new, unwrapped toys and sports equipment for under-served children and teens. The toys collected will be donated to families within our own community.

Donations are also accepted at both Loma Linda fire stations and at Loma Linda City Hall.

The Spark of Love Toy Drive embodies the spirit of compassion, generosity and community involvement during the holiday season.

name: 39th Annual Tinsel Triathlon
description:
Tinsel Triathlon & 5K
Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon
As one of the oldest and largest independently owned reverse sprint pool triathlons on the West Coast, it is certainly an ideal end of the season endurance race.  The 35 year old event truly can be the perfect venue for Triathletes of all levels.  For first timers who have always wanted to be triathletes the course is well defined, attainable and loaded with helpful volunteers.  We are also an awesome setting for the seasoned triathlete. The course layout lets you push yourself hard for a solid workout.  What better way to get your game on ... Reverse Sprint Pool Triathlon!

The Tinsel is a Sunday Triathlon run on a usually sunny, yet crisp, Southern California day with all roads closed and the coffee hot.  The 5K run takes place in a scenic, calm area of West Hemet, California in Riverside County.   Known as a "flat & fast" course, the 12 mile bike ride gives the rider a feeling of being on the country roadside.  The race ends in the 25 meter heated pool at West Valley High School, triathletes will swim 150 meters (up & back 6 times) to the finish line where you receive a unique Tinsel finisher medal.  The awards ceremony follows immediately and the bling is top shelf!

name: 3rd Annual Jerry's Miles for Manhattans
description:
We are back for YEAR 3! A walk honoring the one and only Jerry Fourie! Jerry has done so much for the Pleasanton community, specifically in the area of sports and he was/is truly one of the best there ever will be. Walk participants will loop the Pleasanton Sports Complex to honor him and cherish the memories we had both on and off the softball field. Please join us on December 20th, 2025 for the 2 mile walk (route here).

The walk is free of charge; however, if you would like to make a donation in honor of Jerry Fourie, please donate to the Pleasanton Girls Softball League: The Jerry Fourie Scholarship Fund, a scholarship fund created by his immediate family.

Parking will be available in the two lots off of Parkside Drive that are closest to Hopyard. The rest of the lots east of those parking lots will be inaccessible as fields are closed during the winter.

Lot 1: https://goo.gl/maps/dEyzSxwDp3T41kvz7 

Lot 2: https://goo.gl/maps/mydZMMHZYuzy9U178 

The walk will conclude at 11:30am but all are invited to Porky's Pizza for post gathering fun and perhaps a Manhattan or two to toast Jerry!

We hope to see you on December 20th either in person or virtually!

name: 3rd Annual Porterville 5K/10K Trail Run
description:
Description:

On 4/12/2025, the Porterville Military Academy athletic department is hosting a 5k/10k run/walk starting and finishing at Porterville Military Academy. Join us for a 5k or 10k dirt path course that is out and back. We are also hosting a children's 1/4 mile short course for your little ones to get in on the action. We look forward to seeing your whole family enjoy this community event.

All 5k race participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher Medal
  • Chip time and digital certificate
  • Race bib with individual number
  • Upbeat motivational music
  • Free Parking
All kids 1/4 mile participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher medal

Age Group Winners:

The top three males and the top three females in each age group will be rewarded with a prize after the race! The prize is still being worked on and will be posted here as soon as the artwork comes back. The age groups are...

  • 1-10
  • 11-19
  • 20-29
  • 30-39
  • 40-49
  • 50-59
  • 60-69
  • 70-79
  • 80+

Packet Pickup:

  • Place: Porterville Military Academy front office
  • 4/9/2025 from 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • 4/11/2025 from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • If you are unable to make it to packet pickup, you can come on the morning of the event from 6:30 AM - 7:45 AM

Virtual Race - If you live locally, you are encouraged to come to packet pickup. Otherwise, the race medal will be mailed to you after the race.

We do not store any unclaimed race packets after the race. If you do not pick up your packet prior to the race, then it is considered forfeited. Leftover supplies are donated to volunteers and local charities.

Who we support:

  • The Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA), is an international organization with over 200,000 members. EAA chapters provide a community for pilots and aviation enthusiasts. The Porterville EAA Chapter 1547 has supported Porterville Military Academy Cadets in multiple facets by providing scholarships, overseeing more than 150 Porterville Military Academy Cadets flying an airplane, and mentoring our future aviators on the theories of flight.

name: 41st Nature Made Great Race: Half Marathon, 5K, 10K, 15K, 10M, 1M
description:
The Nature Made Great Race is a celebration of running that features the incredibly scenic Chesebro Half Marathon mostly trail race, and on road: the Deena Kastor 5K, Old Agoura 10K, 15K Double Stack Challenge, Cronies 10.3 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and United Track 1 Mile run/walk.

Established in 1986, the Great Race has won many awards and accolades over the years including:

Best Half Marathon in Nation by Active.com
Voted #1 Running Event in L.A.
Selected a Top 10K in U.S. by Runner's World
Best Race Swag by Competitor Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by LA Sports & Fitness Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by Active.com
Best Post-Race Party by Runner's World
Best Brunch Run by Athlinks 

 

Runner Perks

  • Run on a beautiful, scenic and serene course
  • Custom-designed drawstring goodie bag with actual goodies
  • Premium technical running top (men's or women's cut, in short sleeve or long sleeve)
  • All finishers are rewarded with a beautiful, commemorative finisher’s medal
  • Two medals for finishers of the 10 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and 15K Double Stack Challenge
  • LA's #1 Post-Race Party with lots of quality free food, music and shopping
  • Live Results with RFID timing
  • Photographers on course
  • Plenty of aid stations
  • USATF certified and sanctioned courses
  • Well-marked routes
  • The Great Race Super Discount on Great Race apparel & gear (the earlier you register, the more offers you receive)
  • Sports & Fitness Expo
  • Free parking at the Expo
  • Free race day parking
  • Announcer greets you at beautiful Chumash Park at SoCal’s most active, fun finish line
  • Hundreds of Age Group Awards
  • Prizing: Audio/Video Equipment to Top Finishers in Select Races like TVs, Headphones, Music Players, etc.

Great Race runners comment year-after-year about the gorgeous scenery, the serenity and the most Most Beautiful Courses in Southern California!

So Much Fun!

name: 49th Annual Holiday Run and Walk for Health
description:
We are very excited to bring back the Kiwanis Holiday run. This year will be the 49th running of this event. We have partnered with Rotary Club of the Delta to make sure we bring a high-quality event. We have worked to provide a better course, and lots of medals. We also hope our school’s challenge will be bigger than ever. There will be a medal to the top five runners in every age category, as well as cash prizes and trophies to our top three High school, middle school, and elementary schools. 

Many people have put a lot of work together to make this event happen, none more important than former race director Paul Schorr.

We hope you join us for the 49th Annual – Kiwanis/ Rotary – Paul Schorr Memorial Holiday Run and walk for health. Do it for the Health of It!

name: 55th NorCal John Frank Memorial Run
description:
March 7, 2026

10-Mile USATF Pacific Association Road Grand Prix event.

Run a spring race along the beautiful Sacramento River Trail and across two iconic pedestrian bridges, the Diestelhorst Bridge and the Stress Ribbon Bridge, in Redding, CA.

Plus a 3-Mile Run/Walk and 1 Mile Run/Walk. Kids 14 and under run the 1 Mile for free.

Course Records:

Race day registration opens at 7:30am at Lake Redding Park, 2225 Benton Dr, Redding, CA US 96003.

1 Mile starts at 8:30 AM.
10 Mile starts at 10:00 AM.
3 Mile starts at 10:05 AM.

name: 5K for Fragile X
description:
Superheroes are back once again!! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18th, 2026 for the 13th Annual 5K Walk/Race for Fragile X and celebrate our Southern California Fragile X Community! Click Here for Event Details for Participants 

Why race for Fragile X syndrome? 

Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the leading known cause of inherited intellectual disability and the leading single gene cause of Autism. Fraxsocal’s mission is to promote public awareness and with your help we can accomplish this goal! Also, to provide a forum for families and children with FXS to meet & greet and create a stronger FXS community! We also support research for effective treatments and ultimately a cure for FXS. Treatments for Fragile X are likely to help people affected by autism, Alzheimer’s, and other brain disorders.

Fragile X Community 

A Family Fun Day will proceed after the walk with Family, Friends, Food and Fun!! It's a great time to chat with other families affected by fragile X syndrome (FXS) and it's also a nice opportunity for you to take your kid(s) or adult(s) with FXS or any disability for that matter, judgement free! 

How to participate:
  • Participate in person: Sign up to walk, run, bike, scoot or stroll (it's a very family friendly walk/run) All you do is click the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! Mark your calendar and be sure to arrive early so you can get your FREE t-shirt and goodies before we begin. 
  • Participate virtually: Sign up by clicking the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! (Make sure you have someone there in person to pick up your t-shirts otherwise you will be donating them to our organization in which we say, "thank you"! ) 
  • Start a Fundraiser: Whether you are participating in person or virtually you can start an individual fundraiser (starting goal is $250) and attach it to a TEAM (Starting goal of $2,500) in the honor of your Fragile X Super Hero.
  • Become a Sponsor:  Whether you personally, your company or a company you know are interested we have multiple packages to choose from! 
 
Race Fundraising Goal: $75,000 Last year we raised over $55,000!!! Let's see if we can top that!! Donations can be made by clicking the Donate Tab.
 
Share!

Inform your network of supporters! Use these Social Media graphic template to help you tell others that you are racing and/or fundraising! Invite them to race or donate in your honor or in the honor of your Fragile X Superhero.

 

More about our organization: 
FRAGILE X ASSOCIATION of SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (FRAXSOCAL)
Our non-profit organization was formed to promote public awareness of Fragile X Syndrome with special emphasis on educators and health professionals; provide a forum for families and children with Fragile X to meet and share their ideas, concerns and problems; and support scientific research on Fragile X Syndrome.

name: 71st Annual Fontana Days Run
description: The Fontana Days Run Half Marathon began back in 1955 with a reported 200 participants. Race founders were unaware that the annual Half Marathon would grow to include over 2,000 participants. The Fontana Days Run provides participants with a safe, festive, and well organized event. The Annual Fontana Days Run features a Half Marathon, 5K Run, 5K Family Fitness Walk, and a Children's Half Mile Dash. Finish Line festivities include local vendors, exhibitors, entertainment, and food.

name: 7th Annual Super Bulldog Jog 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Bulldog Jog is a 5K run/walk for all ages.  Course will begin and end inside the school, however the majority of the 5K will run through our surrounding community residential streets.  Located exclusively on the school’s campus, will also be the “Health Fair," which will include “FREE” pre- and post-run festivities (beginning at 7am) featuring a variety of entertainment, as well as health and fitness information.  This event will offer not only finisher medals, shirts, and timed bib at a low cost to those who register, but also fun activities for the whole family at the Health Fair.

-----------------------------------------------------

El Bulldog Jog es una carrera/caminata de 5 km para todas las edades. El recorrido comenzará y terminará dentro de la escuela; sin embargo, la mayor parte de la carrera se realizará por las calles residenciales de nuestra comunidad circundante. Ubicada exclusivamente en el campus de la escuela, también se realizará la "Feria de la Salud", que incluirá actividades gratuitas antes y después de la carrera (a partir de las 7:00 a. m.) con una variedad de entretenimiento, así como información sobre salud y ejercicio. Este evento no solo ofrecerá medallas, camisetas y dorsales cronometrados a bajo costo para quienes se inscriban, sino también actividades divertidas para toda la familia en la Feria de la Salud.

name: 8th Annual KIWANIS  RESOLUTION 5K Run/Walk, and 10K Run/Walk
description:
KIWANIS Resolution Races are in-person runs at Mountain View Shoreline Park! We’ve both a 5K and 10K event to choose from, with Digital  Chip timing for both.

 

This year we are again running on Saturday January 3 to give  holiday travelers a chance to participate too. Start the new year out with a great run on a great day on the Bayland trails!. It's a beautiful location with free parking, great race, with post-race snacks and lots of awards.

 

Please note that no dogs or pets are allowed in Shoreline Park.

 

We will again have a 1K Kids run this year for ages 1-10 and this year all 1K participants will also receive a race T shirt. Plan on bringing all kids and the neighbors too! 

 

Race Day is Jan 3, 2026. The 10K starts at 10:00 AM and the 5K starts at 10:15 AM. All inside Mountain View Shoreline Park. Parking is free for all.  

 

All participants who register by December 15 will receive a specially designed race T-shirt.

 

Also please upload photos from your race experience to this website. We'd love to share your experience of the race. 

 

You may visit our permanent website WSJKrun.org for information about past races and Kiwanis current charitable work. Or Click HERE for more info about Kiwanis of West San Jose and/or HERE for specific programs information.

description:
The BRAVE RACE is hosted by The Joyful Child Foundation - In Memory of Samantha Runnion (55-0794474).

The Joyful Child Foundation is dedicated to preventing crimes against children through programs that educate, empower, and unite families and communities.

Your participation benefits The Joyful Child's Be Brave-Be Safe Empowerment Programs.

You can choose to participate virtually or join us in person at Wolverine Stadium in Aliso Viejo, CA on Sunday, February 22, 2026

Participants can walk or run a 1K, 5K, 10K. Prize money to top 3 male and female in 5k and 10k.

name: 9th Annual Turkey Trot on The Ranch
description:
THANKSGIVING DAY - Thursday, November 27, 2025 | 8:00AM to 10:30AM 
10K - 8:00AM | 5K - 8:30AM  | Little Gobbler's 1K - 10:00AM 

Rancho Mission Viejo’s 9th annual Turkey Trot on The Ranch features a 10K, 5K, and a Little Gobbler’s 1K that takes participants through the beautiful pathways and walkways of the Community of Rancho Mission Viejo. 

All proceeds from the run will benefit The Nature Reserve at Rancho Mission Viejo, the entity responsible for education and conservation of the historic land of Rancho Mission Viejo. This run will happen, rain or shine!

name: A Merry Christmas Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎅 🎄  Join the Christmas Run! 🎄 🎅

Jingle All the Way: A Merry Christmas Run!" is a delightful Holiday run that reminds us of the true essence of Christmas – spreading love, giving selflessly, and cherishing the joy of togetherness with family, friends, and even strangers, all while getting a run in before the Christmas festivities! 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: AAUW Madtown 5K
description: The race begins at 8 am Cedar Creek at 500 N Westberry in Madera, California. The runners will run north on Westberry and then turn left on Riverview until you come to an entrance to run along the cannel. You will turn around at the marked area and return to Cedar Creek where we will have breakfast and provide the runners with their times. Each runner will be provided with a T-shirt.

name: Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run 2026
description:
Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run

This year’s Abrazo 5K Walk and 10K Run embraces the theme “Get Up, Stand Up.” Inspired by Bob Marley’s words, “One love, one heart, let’s get together and feel all right,” we honor his legacy of using music to uplift voices, champion social justice, and spread messages of love, unity, and resilience.

Casa Familiar continues this spirit through our mission of Advancing Communities—even in the face of adversity—by celebrating the strength of our comunidad.

Join us to uplift community wins and support Casa’s youth and senior programs. As a participant, you’ll help us meet growing needs while celebrating together.

Expect lively Rasta vibes, energizing music, and two special awards presented after the race during a short closing program.

Event Details

The Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run takes participants along the scenic San Ysidro–Tijuana border. This year, we’re excited to bring back the Beer Garden — celebrate after the run with a refreshing drink! Beer access is included with your food and drink bracelet.

Welcoming more than 300 participants each year, this annual fundraising event is packed with community spirit, fun, and contagious energy.

Date:

Saturday, May 2, 2026

Schedule:

  • 6:30 AM: Registration 

  • 7:00 AM: Welcome 

  • 7:30 AM: 10K Run

  • 7:35 AM: 5K Walk 

  • 8:45 AM - 11 AM: Awards & Raffles

description:
THIS RACE WILL SELL OUT SOON SO SECURE YOUR SPOT TODAY!

Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 1, 2026 at 10:00am for an exciting annual event that features Akash Winery & Vineyards. Come join us on the gorgeous, open-air patio, where you’ll find far more than beautiful views and amazing wine. This winery is loved by locals and out-of-towners alike, thanks to the happy energy and friendly faces of our knowledgeable team.  So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Alameda Island Running Festival
description:
We are back for another year of racing with our start and end at Faction Brewery. The race start and finish will be right outside, and the Health and Wellness expo presented by Alameda Health Systems will be inside the old hanger.
As with all of our events, a portion of our registrations will be donated to our Beneficiary Alameda Education Foundation. you can read more about them from our direct links below:
  • Alameda Education Foundation: https://alamedaeducationfoundation.org/
 
Race Weekend Packet Pick Up:
  • Thursday and Friday September 17th and 18th : Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St, Alameda, Ca. 94501
    • 10:00am - 6:00pm * we encourage you to get your BIB and shirt early and sleep in race morning! 
  • Saturday 1:00pm - 5:00pm Race Start/Finish Expo 2501 Monarch St, Alameda Point - Faction Brewery
  • Sunday: 6:30am - 8:15am Race Start/Finish Expo 2501 Monarch St. Alameda Point - Faction Brewery
 
Race Events and Schedule: 
  • Saturday: 
    • Hella Bae Running 5k and 1 Mile Shake-out run presented by Skechers : 1:00pm
  •  
  • Sunday 
    • Half Marathon: 7:30am
    • 10K: 8:00am 
    • 5k Presented by Penumbra: 8:15am
    • Family Fun Run: 10:00am
 
Race Timing and Restrictions:

the Island Running Festival is a chip-timed event.  Participants can run, jog or walk the entire course. 
Jogging strollers are permitted but are asked to start in the back of the pack.  Wheelchair athletes are permitted but due to safety concerns and street closure restrictions cannot travel faster than the fastest runner.   No bikes, scooters, skateboards or other wheeled vehicles are allowed. Dogs are not allowed on our race courses.  We love dogs, but there are those who are not so comfortable around them and there are also dogs that are uncomfortable around hundreds of other people, therefore NO DOGS ALLOWED on the course or at the finish line.

We will provide bike parking for those of you that prefer to bike to the event. See the race website for more details. 

 
Event info:
For more detail about the individual events our website

 

Medical and Water Stops:

We will have a dedicated paramedics team on site and available to help assess your race day medical needs and administer acute first aid when necessary. A medical station will be located near the finish line and team members will be roaming the course. 
Water Stops: see maps page for more info
  • Half: Mile 2, 5.5 & 11
  • 10k: Mile 2, 5.5
  • 5k: Mile  2 & 2.5 
 
Volunteers:
We can always use volunteers and it takes the support or our community and friends to make these events successful. if you are interested in learning more visit our website and volunteer support page or reach out to info@outfrontendurance.com

name: Alameda July 4th Parade R.A.C.E.
description:
Come out for our July 4th tradition and run this flat and fast point to point 5k thru the closed streets of Alameda. We will be starting again at 8:30am to provide ample space between our runners and the Parade that follows. 

General Overview: 

The 5K run (3.1 mile) and walk takes you through beautiful Alameda winding thru business and residential streets. This run benefits the Midway Shelter of Alameda. 

Packet Pick-up:

  • 7/1 thru 7/3: Laurens Closet. 1420 Park St, Alameda. Hours 10:00am - 5:00pm  
  • 7/4 Race morning registration opens at 7:30am 1440 Park St, Alameda ~ La Pena corner of Santa Clara (New Location)

Race Day Details: 

  • Start: 1420 Park St. Alameda, ca. 94501
  • Packet Pick-up : 7:30am
  • Race Start : 8:30am
  • Finish: 1526 Webster St, Alameda, CA 94501 (across from Tapout Fitness)

🐣 Get ready to lace up your sneakers and chase some fun!
Join us for the Always Hope Easter Run - a family-friendly, fun, and make memories that’ll last longer than chocolate eggs!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Anaheim Ducks 5K presented by Arrowhead Water
description:
The 4th annual Anaheim Ducks 5K presented by Arrowhead Water is coming back to Great Park in Irvine on Sunday, February 8th!

The course will start right outside of the Ducks practice facility - Great Park Ice & FivePoint Arena - and proceed throughout and around the park.

This year's event will include appearances by Anaheim Ducks mascot Wild Wing, a vendor village with family friendly games and activities, music by DJ JoJo, and much more. All proceeds will benefit the Anaheim Ducks Foundation's mission of producing positive change for children and families throughout Southern California by providing educational opportunities, broadening access to the sport of hockey and addressing the health and wellness needs of the community.

Both competitive and casual runners/walkers are welcome, and each participant will receive a race day t-shirt, finisher's medal, and souvenir runner's bib. Plus - attendees who register for the 'DUCKS 5K + Game Ticket!' option during registration will also receive (1) Terrace Level ticket to a Ducks home game at Honda Center!

name: Anaheim Turkey Trot 5K/10K  -Corner of Katella on the SANTA ANA RIVER TRAIL.  Across the street from Honda Center
description:
Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot 5K/10K
Run up a Thanksgiving appetite at this year’s Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot! Caren Ware Events brings you the ultimate race bling and the best holiday-themed motivation to stay healthy and active. Enjoy a scenic run along the paved Santa Ana River Trail and finish with a view of the iconic “Big A” of Angel Stadium.

Event Location:
Just north of Katella & S Douglas Road on the Santa Ana River Trail, between Angel Stadium and the Honda Center.
Closest Google address: 2610 E. Katella Ave, Anaheim, CA 92806 (former JT Schmid location).

 
What Each Participant Receives:
A collectible themed turkey shirt, beanie, or stuffed event turkey
A custom cast Turkey finisher medal or a choice of race beanie
Chip timing by ITZABOUTTIME with age division awards (3-deep per 5-year span)
A fresh slice of pumpkin pie with whipped cream at the finish
Fun, camaraderie, and holiday cheer
Enjoy music, a festive “along the fence” event expo, Thanksgiving decorations, and photo ops!

 
Race Day Schedule:
6:30 – 8:00 AM: Registration & walk-up packet pick-up
7:50 AM: Warm-up session
7:55 – 8:10 AM: Rolling start for 5K & 10K (must start by 8:10 AM)
8:11 AM: 1-Mile Fun Run start
9:00 AM: 5K Awards Ceremony (top overall & age divisions)
9:30 AM: 10K Awards Ceremony
All participants must wear the correct bib on the front for proper scoring.

 
Early Packet Pickup 

Pickup Details:

TBD

You may pick up packets for others; no ID required.

Race Day Pickup: 6:30 AM at registration booth near start/finish

 
Course Information:
Location: Santa Ana River Trail, Anaheim (paved, multi-use trail)
Enjoy views of Angel Stadium along the way
Shared path with cyclists, walkers, and dog walkers
Safety: Stay right, allow space for others, and follow public path rules
Pro tip: Write what you’re thankful for on your race bib!
 
Parking Information:
Designated Event Parking: Angel Stadium back lot (adjacent to Transit Center) – $10 race day cash pay to attendant or make payment  via zelle carenfasttrack@aol.com or venmo caren-Ware-1 have proof to show attendants. Or prepay when registering.
Enter via Douglas Way off Katella
Proof of parking payment required, (Please show attendant digital parking pass, run sign up payment receipt, Venmo payment, zelle payment  or pay cash)
Limited additional parking at Transit Center Lot B
 
Restrooms:
Public restrooms available at the Transit Center
Limited porta-potties at start/finish and near the 1-mile mark
 
Awards:
Age Division Awards: 1–7, 8–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
Top overall male & female in 5K, 10K, and 1-Mile Fun Run
 
Additional Details:
Street tacos and tamales served at the finish line (vouchers available to be pre-purchase online)
Finisher medals handed out immediately at finish option of beanie (limited quantity)
Event takes place rain or shine
Thank you for supporting Caren Ware Events, spreading health and hope through our races. We look forward to seeing you there!

Questions? Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com

name: Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot
description:
Founded and produced by the Silicon Valley Leadership Group Foundation, the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot is the largest Thanksgiving Day race in America. It allows participants to start Thanksgiving Day off on the right foot by celebrating generosity and wellness with thousands of other runners and walkers committed to investing in their community. All event proceeds are donated to four nonprofit beneficiaries: Healthier Kids Foundation, HomeFirst, Second Harvest of Silicon Valley, and Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County.

This family-focused event welcomes participants of all fitness levels—elite runners, joggers, and walkers—to enjoy the flat and fast course that flows through downtown San Jose's local neighborhoods and businesses.

So kick off the holiday season by joining your Silicon Valley neighbors at San Jose's biggest Thanksgiving Day block party. Sign up to make the Applied Materials Silicon Valley Turkey Trot your newest Thanksgiving tradition!

name: Artesa Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 8, 2026 with start times at 8:30am and 10:30am for an exciting annual event that features Artesa Vineyards Winery. Escape to Artesa Winery, just an hour from San Francisco, and enjoy the finest high-end wines, explore Spanish-inspired architecture, and savor tapas that perfectly complement our exceptional selection. Whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wonderful wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience!  This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!*

name: Ascot Hills Challenge 5K
description:
Event proceeds benefit Wilson High School Fire and Police Magnet Cadet Program and Ascot Hills Park.  

​The Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD) and The Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) have partnered in bringing the very first LAFD fire academy magnet school program to Woodrow Wilson High School in El Sereno, CA, joining the existing LAPD student police cadet program.

 
Join us on the best 3.1 mile trail course in East Los Angeles! 

Our 5K course will challenge all levels of runners, walkers and hikers.  The race is chip-timed for those seeking friendly competition and/or a chance to win a commemorative LAFD challenge coin.

​If you enjoy trail running, walking or hiking, you'll be certain to enjoy this event with spectacular views of Los Angeles, Dodger Stadium and the Hollywood sign, all visible from within the park.

Our 5K course will challenge all levels of runners, walkers and hikers.  The race is chip-timed for those seeking friendly competition and/or a chance to win a commemorative LAFD challenge coin.

​If you enjoy trail running, walking or hiking, you'll be certain to enjoy this event with spectacular views of Los Angeles, Dodger Stadium and the Hollywood sign, all visible from within the park.

name: Auburn Santa Run/Walk 5k
description:
December 21, 2025

Get ready for a festive showdown in the heart of Auburn as the annual Auburn Santa Run 5k takes over the town! This spirited event offers a unique twist as participants have the option to join either Team Santa or Team Grinch, injecting a playful rivalry into the traditional 5k experience.

As the sun begins to rise, the streets of Auburn come alive with the cheerful sounds of jingling bells, festive music, and the laughter of eager participants dressed in their Santa or Grinch-themed running gear. The Auburn Santa Run 5k has become a beloved community tradition, bringing together runners of all ages and fitness levels to celebrate the holiday season in a healthy and joyful way.

The friendly rivalry between Team Santa and Team Grinch adds an extra layer of excitement to the run. Runners on each team encourage and cheer for their teammates, creating a lively atmosphere throughout the course.

VIRTUAL OPTION ADDED:

Our 2025 race is in person, we do have a virtual option. Keep reading to learn how virtual races work.

Virtual races do not have an actual race location, runners sign up and complete a run on their own. The day of the race, DEC 21, runners will receive an email or text message with directions on how and where to send in their results. We need these results to confirm that runners actually completed a run.  You can run any distance you want in any pace. There is no real 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place. This is a great way for runners to stay active an still collect the medal. Race windown is from December 21 to December 25. Your tshirt and finisher medal will be shipped to you. 

Do I have to actually run to get the medal?
Short answer is YES, but walking is also acceptable.
Runners must actually submit results or mark on the results link as to have completed their run to actually receive the medal.

name: Aut2Run for Autism (15K, 5K, 10K, Fun-K, 1 Mile & Virtual Race)
description:
We are excited to welcome you back to an in-person Aut2Run at California State University Channel Islands on Sunday, April 26th, 2026! For those of you who can't experience Aut2Run in-person, but would still like to support Autism Society Ventura County, we will be offering a virtual option for you to participate in. This year is extra special to us as we celebrate Aut2Run's 14th anniversary!

100% of the proceeds from Aut2Run go directly towards fulfilling Autism Society Ventura County's (ASVC) mission to create connections, empowering all with Autism to live fully. ASVC works to promote lifelong access and opportunity for all individuals within the autism spectrum and their families to be fully included members of the community. They achieve this through education, advocacy, a variety of programs, increasing public awareness, and collaboration with other agencies.

ASVC programs are primarily for individuals, families and caregivers who have people in their lives with autism of all ages. We also collaborate with service providers, agency staff, educators and teachers, and professionals who are interested in furthering the mission of ASVC. Their programs are open to any individual, family, or community member impacted by autism. Our Board consists of all dedicated volunteers.

In-Person Race Information: 

10K (1/2 Road & 1/2 Trail) Run - 7:00am Please note, we have a strict course time limit for the 10K. All participants must be able to complete the 10K in 75 minutes (that is a 12 minute per mile pace).  If you do not reach the University Park Entrance (heading back to the South Quad after the trail loop) in 54 minutes, you will be transported to where the 5K joins in at Channel Islands Dr and will receive a DNF (Did Not Finish).
5K Run/Walk - 8:45am
1 Mile Run/Walk - 10:15am
Fun-K - 10:45am This event is for children under age 12 and for adults with special needs and their caregivers. Limited to 300 participants.
15K Hero Run - Participants run both the 10K and 5K events separately. The times from the two races will be combined to give you your 15K results. 

Virtual Race Information & Instructions:
Please choose a local safe route (since this event is virtual you can run​ or walk anywhere you like, we recommend a place that is safe with limited interruptions).
Please follow all local laws, stop at all lights, stop signs and be careful when you cross at any cross walk. ​Please be aware of your surroundings and be cautious as you will not be running or walking on a closed course. We cannot emphasize this enough. 
Maintain, at an absolute minimum, 6ft between you and anyone else not in your household.

Your race packet will be mailed to you the week of the race. 

Tracking your Virtual Race Distance:

Please use a GPS watch or phone with a GPS app (Strava or RunKeeper or two good ones) to track your time and distance. Upon completion you will then add your distance and time onto https://www.aut2run.org/Race/Results/2323#resultSetId-289928;perpage:100 anytime between April 18th and May 1st. Please note, submissions are based on the honor system and there are not awards for the virtual run. 

Packet Pick Up Information:

We highly recommend that all race participants pick up their packets on Saturday!!

Saturday Packet Pickup will help you avoid VERY long lines and reduce anxiety on race morning. The race packet consists of your required race bib, t-shirt, and goodie bag. 

  • Saturday, April 25th 10:00am - 2:00pm at California State University Channel Islands (South Quad)
  • Sunday, April 26th 6:00am - 10:45am at  California State University Channel Islands (South Quad)
    • Please arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your event start time. Expect lines at race morning packet pick up.

For more info on the Aut2Run event go to http://www.aut2run.org/          
For more info on ASVC go to http://www.autismventura.org/

To visit our Donation Gift Store please click here https://squareup.com/store/autism-society-ventura-county

Please consider making a donation and raising funds to benefit Autism support in Ventura County!

ALL registered finishers will receive one of our unique finisher medals and a soft event t-shirt.  Additional t-shirts, hats and other items are available for purchase in limited quantities at the event.

Make sure to use #Aut2Run!

10K (1/2 Road & 1/2 Trail) Run - 7:00am Please note, we have a strict course time limit for the 10K. All participants must be able to complete the 10K in 75 minutes (that is a 12 minute per mile pace).  If you do not reach the University Park Entrance (heading back to the South Quad after the trail loop) in 54 minutes, you will be transported to where the 5K joins in at Channel Islands Dr and will receive a DNF (Did Not Finish).
5K Run/Walk - 8:45am
1 Mile Run/Walk - 10:15am
Fun-K - 10:45am This event is for children under age 12 and for adults with special needs and their caregivers. Limited to 300 participants.
15K Hero Run - Participants run both the 10K and 5K events separately. The times from the two races will be combined to give you your 15K results. 

Virtual Race Information & Instructions:
Please choose a local safe route (since this event is virtual you can run​ or walk anywhere you like, we recommend a place that is safe with limited interruptions).
Please follow all local laws, stop at all lights, stop signs and be careful when you cross at any cross walk. ​Please be aware of your surroundings and be cautious as you will not be running or walking on a closed course. We cannot emphasize this enough. 
Maintain, at an absolute minimum, 6ft between you and anyone else not in your household.

Your race packet will be mailed to you the week of the race. 

Tracking your Virtual Race Distance:

Please use a GPS watch or phone with a GPS app (Strava or RunKeeper or two good ones) to track your time and distance. Upon completion you will then add your distance and time onto https://www.aut2run.org/Race/Results/2323#resultSetId-289928;perpage:100 anytime between April 18th and May 1st. Please note, submissions are based on the honor system and there are not awards for the virtual run. 

Packet Pick Up Information:

We highly recommend that all race participants pick up their packets on Saturday!!

Saturday Packet Pickup will help you avoid VERY long lines and reduce anxiety on race morning. The race packet consists of your required race bib, t-shirt, and goodie bag. 

  • Saturday, April 25th 10:00am - 2:00pm at California State University Channel Islands (South Quad)
  • Sunday, April 26th 6:00am - 10:45am at  California State University Channel Islands (South Quad)
    • Please arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your event start time. Expect lines at race morning packet pick up.

For more info on the Aut2Run event go to http://www.aut2run.org/          
For more info on ASVC go to http://www.autismventura.org/

To visit our Donation Gift Store please click here https://squareup.com/store/autism-society-ventura-county

Please consider making a donation and raising funds to benefit Autism support in Ventura County!

ALL registered finishers will receive one of our unique finisher medals and a soft event t-shirt.  Additional t-shirts, hats and other items are available for purchase in limited quantities at the event.

Make sure to use #Aut2Run!

description:

name: Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run
description: The Avalon Benefit 50 Mile/50K Run is the oldest Ultra Trail Run in California with the 50 Mile run entering its 43rd year.   The 50K joined the party six years ago and instantly became a California classic in trail running traversing all of the same trails that the older run uses.   Running the Avalon Benefit 50Mile/50K provides you a first rate, up-close and personal experience of one of California's natural jewels in trail running across Catalina Island.   The run begins and ends in Avalon and in between you simply have to run the entire length of the island - and back!  In between you will experience beautiful vistas, tremendous views of the Pacific Ocean, see a bison or two and experience some of the sports great volunteers and aid stations.

name: Avenal's 5k Turkey Trot
description:
Get ready to move your feet before you eat! Join us for Avenal’s Turkey Trot, a community fun run that brings families, friends, and neighbors together to celebrate the season in a healthy, active way. Whether you are running for fun or for fitness, this event is all about community, gratitude, and giving back. Participants are encouraged to wear their best Thanksgiving-themed outfits. The first 50 sign ups will receive a Turkey Trot shirt. All proceeds from the Turkey Trot will go toward providing food baskets for families in need this Thanksgiving. 
---
¡Prepárate para moverte antes de comer! Únete al Turkey Trot de Avenal, una carrera recreativa que reúne a familias, amigos y vecinos para celebrar la temporada de una manera saludable y activa. Ya sea que corras por diversión o por ejercicio, este evento se trata de comunidad, gratitud y generosidad. Se invita a los participantes a usar sus mejores atuendos con tema de Día de Acción de Gracias. Las primeras 50 inscripciones recibirán una camiseta del Turkey Trot. Todos los fondos recaudados se destinarán a proporcionar canastas de alimentos para las familias necesitadas este Día de Acción de Gracias.

name: Aztlan XC Classic
description:
Aztlan XC Classic was established in 1976. It has been long due and now we welcome you back. This time, those who have competed at this event are now well into their 50s. You are now coaches, mentors, teachers, parents and even grandparents. Bring your family, team or if you're still challenging yourself then sign up and let’s celebrate our success.

This event exclusively benefits Aztlan Athletics Foundation (AAF). For details about the subsidized running camps, scholarships, and complimentary registrations visit AztlanAthleticsFoundation.org.

name: Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half
description:
Back to the Future: 88 MPH Dash 5K, 10K & Half

October 17, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Get ready to rev up your DeLorean and hit 88 MPH! This race celebrates the iconic Back to the Future trilogy, with a special nod to Back to the Future Day—October 21—the 2015 date Marty McFly and Doc Brown traveled to the future in Back to the Future Part II.

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Whether you're a time-traveling teen or a mad scientist, this race lets you channel your inner McFly and dash through time with style.

---

  • 88 MPH Sprint 5K⚡ Perfect for those looking to make a quick getaway from 1985.
  • Twin Pines 10K 🌲 A tribute to the mall where it all began—before the pine trees were history.
  • Enchantment Under the Run Half Marathon 🎶 Dance through time and space in this nostalgic long-distance challenge.
  • The Multiverse Flux Capacitor Challenge (Virtual) 🌀 Can't make it in person? Join us virtually and complete any distance to earn your medal.

Expect time-traveling tunes, futuristic photo ops, and plenty of 80s nostalgia. Costumes encouraged—think puffer vests, lab coats, and hoverboards!


---

📦 Multiverse Option (Virtual Runners Welcome!)

Can't make it IRL? Run virtually anytime from Oct 18–21, and we'll ship you your finisher medal. No need for a time machine!

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race—fun, fast, and full of nostalgia.

Sign up now. The future is what you make it—so make it a good one!


---

This race is a fan-made parody event inspired by 80s pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official trademark holders.

name: Badwater 267 VR
description:
BADWATER: It’s a frame of mind, a global family of horizon-chasers, and a statement to the world about priorities and preconceived notions of what is possible. Badwater is a way of life! Are you ready to kick off the New Year with an authentic, original Badwater experience?

AdventureCORPS® – the organizers of the iconic worldwide series of Badwater® races – are pleased to offer the BADWATER 267 VR in which competitors virtually and sequentially traverse the routes of all three Badwater® races – the 51-mile Badwater Cape Fear, the 81-mile Badwater Salton Sea, and the 135-mile Badwater 135 – for a total of 267 miles, or 430km. These three events comprise the legendary Badwater Ultra Cup - and Badwater 267 VR! Start off the New Year with this new challenge and immerse yourself in the world of Badwater!

If you are up to the challenge, you will complete 267 miles (430km) during the month of January. You have 31 days to complete 267 miles on foot - or 133.5 miles swimming, 801 miles cycling  - and you can do them anywhere you want, including indoors. There is also a multi-sport division for those who want to combine different sports (including paddle sports, cross-country and downhill skiing, skateboarding, and more; see below.) Participation is based on the “honor system,” but there is a highly recommended - and very popular - Private Strava Club to bring everyone together.

Go at your own pace, as often or as long as you want, wherever you live, anywhere on the planet! 

Guidelines:

• Running Division: You must complete all 267 miles on foot: This includes Walking, Hiking, Snowshoeing, and Treadmill, whether indoors or outdoors, covering 267 miles (430km) in 31 days. This is the Running Division, in which ONLY these bipedal activities may be counted. Also Note: In the Strava app, always log any of these activities as "Running" so that they appear on the club leaderboard.

NOTE: Elliptical is NOT allowed in the Running Division. 

• Cycling division: You must bike all the miles, whether outdoors, indoors, or both. (For logging and covering the 267-mile course, 3 miles cycling = 1 mile running. If you are cycling indoors, please make it realistic.)

NOTE: Indoor bike rides with an average speed of more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH DO NOT COUNT. 

• Multi-Sport division: MANY sports may be included, besides, cycling, swimming, and running: All paddle and rowing sports, ice-skating, rollerblading, skateboarding, and cross-country skiing are also allowed in the multi-sport category, and all they all count one-for-one.

For swimming, 1 mile swimming = 2 miles running. Similarly, for prone paddling - i.e. no paddle - this is considered equivalent to swimming and counts 2 miles for each 1 mile paddled.

For Elliptical, you must go 2 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. (Elliptical is only allowed in the Multi-Sport division, NOT in the Running division.)

• Strength training counts in the Multi-Sport division: 1 hour of strength training equates to 4 miles of running. Also, Yoga and other types of fitness classes count as 3 miles for a one-hour class.

• Downhill skiing or snowboarding also count: 1150 feet of vert = one mile, thus 10,000 feet of vert equals the 8.67-mile daily requirement. (A total of 307,050 for 267 miles!)

• Cycling: Indoor bike rides with an average speed of more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH DO NOT COUNT. 

SWAG & AWARDS:

Participants will receive a BADWATER 267 VR tech shirt, BADWATER buff, and BADWATER sunglasses in a custom Badwater box. For those who log the necessary miles within the RunSignUp system, a BADWATER 267 VR Medal will also be awarded. (Medals are not sent just for participating; they are sent to those who cover the distance AND log all the necessary miles with the RunSignUp system.) These items will be shipped approximately 45 days after BADWATER 267 VR concludes. See the event webpage for all the info.

This is not a traditional ultra, nor a run-of-the-mill virtual – Badwater events are NEVER traditional – it’s the BADWATER 267 VR – an authentic and original BADWATER event – and we hope you will join us!

POLICIES:

There are NO refunds after December 30. There are also no credits or transfers.

See the event webpage for all the info.

name: Badwater 267 VR
description:
BADWATER: It’s a frame of mind, a global family of horizon-chasers, and a statement to the world about priorities and preconceived notions of what is possible. Badwater is a way of life! Are you ready to kick off the New Year with an authentic, original Badwater experience?

AdventureCORPS® – the organizers of the iconic worldwide series of Badwater® races – are pleased to offer the BADWATER 267 VR in which competitors virtually and sequentially traverse the routes of all three Badwater® races – the 51-mile Badwater Cape Fear, the 81-mile Badwater Salton Sea, and the 135-mile Badwater 135 – for a total of 267 miles, or 430km. These three events comprise the legendary Badwater Ultra Cup - and Badwater 267 VR! Start off the New Year with this new challenge and immerse yourself in the world of Badwater!

If you are up to the challenge, you will complete 267 miles (430km) during the month of January. You have 31 days to complete 267 miles on foot - or 133.5 miles swimming, 801 miles cycling  - and you can do them anywhere you want, including indoors. There is also a multi-sport division for those who want to combine different sports (including paddle sports, cross-country and downhill skiing, skateboarding, and more; see below.) Participation is based on the “honor system,” but there is a highly recommended - and very popular - Private Strava Club to bring everyone together.

Go at your own pace, as often or as long as you want, wherever you live, anywhere on the planet! 

Guidelines:

• Running Division: You must complete all 267 miles on foot: This includes Walking, Hiking, Snowshoeing, and Treadmill, whether indoors or outdoors, covering 267 miles (430km) in 31 days. This is the Running Division, in which ONLY these bipedal activities may be counted. Also Note: In the Strava app, always log any of these activities as "Running" so that they appear on the club leaderboard.

NOTE: Elliptical is NOT allowed in the Running Division. 

• Cycling division: You must bike all the miles, whether outdoors, indoors, or both. (For logging and covering the 267-mile course, 3 miles cycling = 1 mile running. If you are cycling indoors, please make it realistic.)

NOTE: Indoor bike rides with an average speed of more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH DO NOT COUNT. 

• Multi-Sport division: MANY sports may be included, besides, cycling, swimming, and running: All paddle and rowing sports, ice-skating, rollerblading, skateboarding, and cross-country skiing are also allowed in the multi-sport category, and all they all count one-for-one.

For swimming, 1 mile swimming = 2 miles running. Similarly, for prone paddling - i.e. no paddle - this is considered equivalent to swimming and counts 2 miles for each 1 mile paddled.

For Elliptical, you must go 2 miles - with some intensity, NOT in the easiest setting - to log 1 mile in the RunSignUp system. (Elliptical is only allowed in the Multi-Sport division, NOT in the Running division.)

• Strength training counts in the Multi-Sport division: 1 hour of strength training equates to 4 miles of running. Also, Yoga and other types of fitness classes count as 3 miles for a one-hour class.

• Downhill skiing or snowboarding also count: 1150 feet of vert = one mile, thus 10,000 feet of vert equals the 8.67-mile daily requirement. (A total of 307,050 for 267 miles!)

• Cycling: Indoor bike rides with an average speed of more than 16MPH / 25.75KPH DO NOT COUNT. 

SWAG & AWARDS:

Participants will receive a BADWATER 267 VR tech shirt, BADWATER buff, and BADWATER sunglasses in a custom Badwater box. For those who log the necessary miles within the RunSignUp system, a BADWATER 267 VR Medal will also be awarded. (Medals are not sent just for participating; they are sent to those who cover the distance AND log all the necessary miles with the RunSignUp system.) These items will be shipped approximately 45 days after BADWATER 267 VR concludes. See the event webpage for all the info.

This is not a traditional ultra, nor a run-of-the-mill virtual – Badwater events are NEVER traditional – it’s the BADWATER 267 VR – an authentic and original BADWATER event – and we hope you will join us!

POLICIES:

There are NO refunds after December 30. There are also no credits or transfers.

See the event webpage for all the info.
