Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Letters from Santa
description:
Greetings from the North Pole! Have a personalized letter from Santa sent to your loved ones or anyone in need of a gentle reminder to believe in the magical wonders this winter season.

 

Each purchase includes: personalized letter, matching envelope, authentic North Pole wax seal, and Santa's signature.

 

Letter templates can be selected in the questions during registration. Registration is open until December 8.

 

All letters will be mailed to the address of your choice on December 12th. Please make sure to fill out the question portion of the registration with the exact wording you would like.

 

 

Letter Template A

Dear <childs_first_name>,

 

Ho! Ho! Ho! Everyone here at the North Pole sends you their love and best wishes.

 

This year, my elves worked very hard to finish making all of the toys and gifts early. They even loaded them in my flying sleigh and it looks like everything is ready for the big trip around the world. The reindeer are relaxing and having a nice cup of hot cocoa. As for the elves, I see them playing outside in the snow! They are building snow forts and having snowball fights.

 

Mrs. Claus tells me that you have been a good <childs_gender> this year. I hear that you <an_accomplishment>. We are very proud of you, our friend from <city_you_live_in>.

 

Remember to keep being good and playing nicely with your <friend>. I look forward to visiting <city_you_live_in> and bringing your special present, just in time for Christmas!

 

P.S. <special_note>

 

Letter Template B

Dear <childs_name>,

 

I am writing this letter to you because you are officially on the NICE list! Everyone here at the North Pole is so proud of you for being such a good <childs_gender>. I can’t wait to visit your home in <city_you_live_in> to put your special present under the Christmas tree.

 

Up at the North Pole, the elves are playing Christmas music in the workshop while the reindeers fly outside. They all had a race and Rudolph won! Mrs. Claus made hot cocoa for everyone to stay warm in this snowy weather. It’s much colder than <city_you_live_in>!

 

I hope that you continue to be kind and play nicely with <friend>. I also noticed that this year you <an_accomplishment>. Keep up the great work and keep spreading Christmas cheer!

 

Ho! Ho! Ho!

 

P.S. <special_note>

 

 

Letter Template C

Shalom <childs_name>!

 

Happy Hanukkah! I hope you are excited to celebrate the Festival of Lights this year. It is time to get out your menorah and spin your dreidel!

 

I hear that this year you have been as brave and smart as the Maccabees. I am especially proud of you for <an_accomplishment>. I hope you are excited to share some latkes with <friend>. I know your candles will glow beautifully in <city_you_live_in>.

 

L’chaim!

 

 

PS <Special note>

name: Lights for Life 5K
description:
The team at Project 99 invites you to join us for the Lights for Life 5K, our signature mental health and suicide awareness campaign. This year’s event continues our mission to shine a light on suicide prevention and bring the conversation "out of the dark." Your participation helps us spread hope, raise awareness, and ensure that no one feels alone in their struggles.
By running, walking, or supporting this 5K, you are directly contributing to our efforts to educate local students and the broader community about mental health and suicide prevention. Project 99 Play for Life, Inc., is so grateful for the generous support that allows us to make an impact today and grow our mission for the future. All additional donations are tax-deductible and will help us expand our educational outreach, keeping students engaged and encouraging them to "stay in the game" and play for life.
In addition to participating in the race, we encourage youth to get involved behind the scenes, with opportunities to volunteer in event planning, preparation, and execution. Together, we can continue to build a community where mental health is prioritized, and no one is left in the dark.
Let's bring hope, awareness, and prevention into the light.

name: Lookin' for a Cure Palo Alto
description:
Description

Join Us in the Pursuit of a Cure at the Lookin' For A Cure Palo Alto 5K!


Every year, Lookin' For A Cure 5k events light up cities across the United States. These events are not just about running, they are about igniting awareness, and unity in the fight against Ocular Melanoma. By participating, you're not only support groundbreaking research but also bringing together individuals affected by Ocular Melanoma.We are Lookin' For a Cure" in Palo Alto. Join A Cure in Sight on Saturday July 11th, 7AM-11AM at: 2452 Watson Ct. Palo Alto, CA US 94020. Help raise awareness and support the fight against Ocular Melanoma, the most common eye cancer in adults in the United States.  

A Partnership for Progress


A Cure In Sight collaborates with leading research facilities and dedicated physicians that specialize in Ocular Melanoma treatment. Together, we channel the net proceeds from these events into ongoing research projects and patient support programs. Your involvement directly contributes to advancing the quest for a cure. Walk shoulder-to-shoulder with Ocular Melanoma survivors, their families, and the medical professionals who care for them at the Byers Eye Institute at Stanford University School of Medicine. 

All ages are welcome to attend. Come run, walk, or stay in one place and play games at the Third Annual Lookin' for a Cure 5K at Stanford, hosted by A Cure in Sight and the Byers Eye Institute at Stanford.  Set up your team, invite your friends and family, start your fundraiser and you are off to the finish line. Proceeds from this event will support the Stanford Ocular Oncology Program. Stanford is a national leader in providing state-of-the-art care for ocular melanoma patients of all ages and has pioneered groundbreaking research advances. Prithvi Mruthyunjaya, MD, MHS, professor of ophthalmology who anchors the ocular tumor service at Stanford is also working hard at Stanford to bring this event to fruition.

The race also aims to spread the word about the importance of early detection by getting regular dilated eye exams. Ocular melanoma makes up approximately 5 percent of melanomas in the United States. It is estimated that between 6-8 people per million will be diagnosed annually in the Western world. 

Read more about the work Stanford is doing around ocular melanoma here.

Event Details

Packet pick up will be held at Road Runner Sports San Carlos located at: 1125 Industrial Rd, San Carlos, CA 94070 on Friday, July 10th, 2026 from 4PM to 7PM. Come by and grab your race swag and pick up those last minute items that you need to be race ready. 

Race Swag

  • Guaranteed T-shirt, If Registered by June 28th.
  • Finisher Medal
  • Food & Drink
  • Course Aid Station
  • Commemorative Race Bib
  • Free Downloadable Photos
  • Official Finishers Time With Age Group Placements

Race day schedule

  • Registration 7 AM
  • Race start 8 AM
  • Announcements Awards 9:30 am

Free parking is available in the Byers Eye Institute parking lot on the corner of Embarcadero Rd. and Bayshore Rd.

name: Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay | 5K & Kid Run
description:
Get ready for an unforgettable evening of trail running at the Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay & 5K! This race brings together adventure, teamwork, and breathtaking views in one epic event. As the sun sets over the city, you'll traverse scenic trails, soak in stunning skyline views, and take on a thrilling course through the heart of Griffith Park.

🏃 10 Mile Relay – Teams of 4! Gather your crew, with each runner completing the same scenic loop before passing the baton. It's the perfect mix of teamwork, strategy, and fun!

 

🏃 5K Solo Race! A thoughtfully designed route that balances challenge and enjoyment — perfect for experienced trail runners and those new to the sport.

 

Whether you're racing with a team of four or taking on the 5K solo, this event is the perfect way to push your limits, connect with fellow runners, and embrace the magic of trail running under the evening sky. With well-stocked aid stations, an enthusiastic volunteer crew, and an electrifying atmosphere, you'll have everything you need to make this race one to remember.

So grab your teammates, lace up your trail shoes, and join us for an incredible night of running, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments! Register now and experience the Los Angeles Sunset Trail Relay & 5K like never before!

 

Each Participant receives:

  • Scenic, and well marked courses

  • Panoramic views of Griffith Park, the LA River, and Glendale.

  • Ultra-soft, ultra-comfy premium gender specific short sleeve t-shirt*

  • Unique Finisher’s medal for all participants

  • Prizes from our sponsors awarded to the top 3 teams (Relay Only).

  • Exclusive Captain, and Anchor Badge for Last Leg Runners (Relay only)

  • Special Award for Overall and Age Grade Division Winners (5K only)

  • Special Awards for the Largest club, Corporate team, and the team with the funniest name (Relay Only)

  • Free Downloadable Race Photos from our experienced photography team

  • Live Music

  • Chip time results

  • Course Aid Stations with medical staff

  • Custom Bibs

  • Enthusiastic Volunteer Support

  • Finish Line Fruit, Snacks, Refreshments, and Full Body Wipes

  • Flexible deferral and transfer options

  • Access to the exclusive Los Angeles Sunset Trail Run sale at Fleet Feet Burbank

  • Lifelong memories with friends!

name: LSA's Run Home 2026
description:
This is a fundraiser for Life Services Alternatives which provides homes and services for the I/DD community in the Bay Area.

 

Please register to race and donate, or just donate!

 

Life Services Alternatives Run Home

Life Services Alternatives celebrates 22 years after opening their first home with a Live Race Event

  • Race Distances -- 5K, 10K

  • Virtual Run Distances - 5k, 10k - for those who are unable to join on race day.

 

Register early before price goes up and to secure your T-shirt (Shirt sizes subject to availability).  Take advantage of $5 early bird special discount until June 3rd. 

 

Register for LSA's Run Home Here!

Life Services Alternatives, Inc sponsors this race and is the beneficiary. All participants are encouraged to donate and or raise funds for the Life Services Alternatives cause. If you are not a runner or are unable to run you are still available to donate to Life Services Alternatives!

 

About Life Services Alternatives

Life Services Alternatives provides exceptional community living and programs for adults with developmental disabilities. 
 
In our county, there is a housing shortage for adults with development disabilities. In the past 4 years, over 40 programs have closed due staffing issues, low government rates and the high cost of living in the Silicon Valley. A high percentage of adults with developmental disabilities live at home with their parents. Unfortunately, parents age, have health issues, or they can no longer care for their adult child. Parents worry about who will take care of their adult child when they no longer can.
 
Life Services Alternatives helps to alleviate those worries. We opened our first three homes in 2004 in Santa Clara. It was a goal of Life Services Alternatives to establish homes where residents could grow and thrive in a non-institutional setting.  We currently have 15 licensed homes throughout Santa Clara County (San Jose, Campbell, Santa Clara and Morgan Hill) that are home to men and women who are developmentally disabled. Our residents’ range in age from 20 to 80 years old with a wide range of disabilities. 16th home is in the process of renovation and retrofitting to meet the community home standards. Five of our fifteen homes are for individuals who have special health care needs and intensive support needs. Our remaining nine homes, are home to residents who need 24-hour a day, non-medical care and supervision. It is Life Services Alternatives goal to continue to open new homes in our county where residents can live their best possible lives. Your support is needed to reach our goal. Your donation is greatly appreciated and will help change the lives of a developmentally disabled adult.

description:

It’s a celebration of fitness, fun, and flavor for all ages! NEW FOR 2025: OUR EVENT WILL TAKE PLACE AT FRESNO CITY COLLEGE AS WE'LL HAVE A REAL "LUCHA LIBRE" WRESTLING MATCH AT THE END OF THE EVENT!

  • Post-Race Fiesta: Celebrate at the finish line with delicious tacos, hot chocolate, and "pan dulce" waiting to refuel you.
  • Support Local Fitness: As with all Reyes Racing events, this run brings the community together to stay active and celebrate the joy of movement.

  • TACOS

  • ATHENA/CLYDESDALE age group divisions
  • BEST COSTUME competition
  • GREAT RUNNING COURSE, FLAT AT FRESNO CITY COLLEGE CAMPUS!

  • FUN, MUSIC!

name: Lunar New Year Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🏇🐎 Gallop Into the New Year! 🐎🏇
✨ Step into the Year of the Horse with purpose, energy, and community spirit! ✨
Celebrate culture, fitness, and fresh starts with the Lunar New Year’s Run, which is your chance to embrace the bold spirit of the horse - symbolizing energy, freedom, and forward momentum.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

🏇🐎 Gallop Into the New Year! 🐎🏇
✨ Step into the Year of the Horse with purpose, energy, and community spirit! ✨
Celebrate culture, fitness, and fresh starts with the Lunar New Year’s Run, which is your chance to embrace the bold spirit of the horse - symbolizing energy, freedom, and forward momentum.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Mammoth Bar Trail Runs
description:
"Standard distance. Mammoth vert."

Mammoth Bar Trail Runs take place on the single-track and double-track trails of Mammoth Bar OHV Area in Auburn State Recreation Area, in the Endurance Capital of Auburn, California.

Mammoth Bar is known for its steep climbs and descents, as well as it's beautiful American River Canyon views.

These are not your average courses. You get more vert per dollar! Yay!

Mammoth Bar is a new event put on by Skybreaker Racing's Race Director under the Singletrack Running umbrella.

name: MaraFUNrun 5K
description:
Runnin’ for Rhett hosts the MaraFUNrun in Land Park this year!

3,000 youth athletes from the Sacramento area take part in a 5K race celebrating the completion of six weeks of participation in our after-school Youth Fitness Program. You can support our local youth by joining us! Register to run, walk, or jog with the kids in our community 5K, volunteer your time, come out to cheer, or make a donation to help keep our Youth Fitness Program free for these youth athletes. It’s also the perfect shake-out before the big Marathon on Sunday.

name: March for Marrow California
description:
We invite patients and their friends and families throughout the state of California to be with us in-person or virtually for our 16th Annual March for Marrow at the iconic Shoreline Village, in Long Beach, CA. We will run or walk along the beautiful shore and FUNDRAISE for the Aplastic Anemia and MDS International Foundation, Inc. (AAMDSIF).

AAMDSIF provides education, support, and hope for patients living with aplastic anemia, myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS), paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) and related bone marrow failure diseases.

name: Martha's Village & Kitchen 19th Annual Thanksgiving Day 5K
description:
Martha's Village & Kitchen Thanksgiving Day 5k is an annual, family-friendly, run/walk fundraiser in Palm Desert, CA. The goal of the 5K is to raise awareness about Martha’s Village & Kitchen’s services and to provide funds to support our mission to end hunger and homelessness in the Coachella Valley. Over 5,000 people attend the event including participants, spectators, and volunteers.

  1. Register yourself as an individual, start a team or join an existing team.
  2. Pick up your essential race gear on the packet pick-up days to be determined.
  3. Watch the KESQ News Channel 3 news team, feature stories about Martha's Village.  Segments will be recorded and available for viewing throughout the weekend.
  4. Gather family, friends or create your own team and get ready to run or walk!  
  5. Visit our sponsorship page on our website to learn more about the businesses that are supporting our community.
  6. Lastly, don’t forget to post pics and tag @MarthasVilllage or hashtag #MVK5K on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter and show your spirit!

name: Mash + Dash – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Still full? Perfect. Mash & Dash is here to help you run off that mountain of mashed potatoes with a morning of coastal miles and post-feast fun. It’s the perfect way to keep the holiday vibes rolling while giving those leftovers a little competition. Whether you’re out to burn off pie slices or just want an easy cruise by the water, this run is all about laughter, movement, and shaking off that Thanksgiving food coma.

Race Details

Start Location: 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA 90803
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
1:00-4:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event & post-race)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon and 10-miler start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged in advance for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More About the Course

This is an out and back course, meaning you will begin and finish in the same location.

Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Safety is must and all runners must stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path. The course never goes off the beach path.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations and restrooms along the way. Turns will be clearly marked with chalk, a sign that says runner turn, and a flag.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: May the 4th be with You- The Empire Strides Back  5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
May the 4th Be With You – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon | Long Beach

The Empire Strides Back – Medals, Chip Timing, Photos, Costume Fun!

Join us for the May the 4th Be With You 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon in Long Beach, California! Chip-timed running event, medals for all finishers, free race-day photos, costume-friendly race atmosphere, flat coastal course, and family-friendly fun.

 

🏅 Everyone Gets a Medal – No Force Powers Required!
Empire Strides Back – May the 4th Be With You 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd Long Beach, CA 90803
🗓 Sunday- May 3rd, 2025

 

This is a chip timed event. Overall awards and Age Group Awards

 
👟 Start Times:
Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K: 7:30 AM
Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM – 7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
 
🚗 Parking:
Street parking is free. Lot parking is $2.00 per hour. Pay at machine in parking lot
 
🌌 Why You Should Join:
Ready to race through the galaxy? Whether you’re a Jedi, Sith, or Rebel runner, come show off your Force in this high-vibe, costumed run along the scenic Long Beach waterfront.

🎭 Costumes encouraged! Come dressed as your favorite hero, villain, or creature.
📸 Epic photo ops with galaxy props and backdrops.
🎶 Out-of-this-world vibes with music, cheering, and space-age fun.
 
💫 Distances for All:
Ignite your journey with the 5K
Fuel your power with the 10K
Go full galaxy mode in the Half Marathon
 
🎉 Event Perks:
🏅 Everyone gets a finisher medal
📸 Free race-day photos
🔄 Chip-timed results posted on-site
🚰 Water stations & restrooms on course
👶 Stroller-friendly and beginner-welcoming
 
🌞 Why CaliFlow Runs?
We’re runners putting on races for runners. Affordable, authentic, and always a vibe — we believe in good energy, fun themes, and creating an inclusive space for all paces. Whether you're here to PR or just play dress-up and stroll, you're part of the tribe.

 
🎟 Sign up now and let the Force (and your feet) guide you!
#EmpireStridesBack #CaliFlowRuns #MayThe4thBeWithYou #RunWithTheForce #GalaxyRunVibes #FinishLineFeels

name: Memorial Day 5K, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Run/Walk
description:
This favorite Memorial Day running event takes place near the beautiful Diamond Valley Lake in Hemet, CA. This flat, out, and back course is perfect for your next PR or for those just starting their journey. Runners and walkers of all experience levels are invited to come out and enjoy the Memorial Day festivities! With a 5K Run/Walk (3.1 miles),10K Run/Walk (6.2 miles), and our iconic Kid’s Run (1 Mile), there is something for everyone!

Why Run The Memorial Day 5K, 5 Mile, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Run?

  • Flat & Fast Course in Hemet, CA 
  • Awesome and well-designed race bibs, shirts & medals
  • 10 minutes from Southern California Wineries
  • Lots of excitement in Old Town and Temecula’s Premier Mall
  • Locally owned & locally produced – Memorial Day 5K, 10K & Kids 1 Mile Race is a homegrown race!

Included in your registration:

  • Technical fabric, men’s and women’s race shirts
  • Custom finisher’s medal
  • Chip Timing
  • Support stations 
  • Post-race refreshments
  • Finish line expo

 

Race Start Times:

10K: 7:30 AM

5K: 7:45 AM 

Kids 1 Mile: 9:00 AM

name: Memorial Day Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Honor, Remember, and Run for Freedom This Memorial Day, join us for the Memorial Day Freedom Run - a special event that combines a run with the powerful spirit of remembrance.  Whether you're running solo or with friends and family, this event honors the brave men and women who have sacrificed for our freedom.
Every mile you complete is a tribute to their courage and service.  With scenic routes, motivating challenges, and a community united in purpose, the Memorial Day Freedom Run is more than just a race - it's a meaningful way to pay respect while staying active. 
Sign up today to celebrate freedom, remember our heroes, and run for a cause that matters.  Together, we can make this Memorial Day unforgettable.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Merced River Canyon Run
description:
Mariposa county's classic Merced River Canyon Race returns this year with two options for runners.  

McCabe Flat Flat out. This 5 mile race is from the Briceburg bridge to McCabe Flat campground and back (2.5 each way).  As the name suggests this race is about as flat as a race in the foothills can be. This race can be done at any pace but some will choose to try and set a record on the flattest footrace in the county. 

Burma Grade. This 9 mile race starts at the river level and climbs up the mighty Burma Grade (4.5 each way). This race offers the most elevation of any foot race in the county and leaves the racers with an amazing sense of accomplishment.  

Both races are on hardpacked unpaved roads and offer amazing scenery in the Merced River Canyon.

Note on location and directions, please take highway 140 to get to Briceburg. While there are other ways to get here, they are not recommend, especially not on race day.

name: Merry Miles- Naughty or Nice Run  5K, 10K,  and Half Marathon
description:
🎅 Merry Miles: Naughty or Nice Christmas Run
📅 Sunday, December 14, 2025
📍 Alamitos Beach – 780 E Shoreline Dr, Long Beach, CA 90802

 
🎄 Run for a Cause, Give from the Heart — This Time for Our Furry Friends!


Are you on the Naughty List or the Nice List this year? 😇😈
Either way, grab your Santa hats, elf ears, or that questionable holiday sweater and come jingle those miles at the Merry Miles: Naughty or Nice Run!

This festive coastal run is all about holiday spirit, good vibes, and giving back — plus, we’re collecting donations for the Long Beach Animal Shelter to help local pets in need. 🐾
Bring a toy, treat, blanket, or bag of food from their wish list (posted at check-in) and help spread pawsitive cheer to our four-legged friends waiting for their forever homes.

 
🏃‍♀️ Event Highlights
✨ Professional  chip timing on a flat, fast course
📸 Elfie Stations & finish-line photo ops galore
🏅  Naughty or Nice finisher medals — which one will you earn?
🎅 Costumes encouraged! Dress festive, funny, or fabulously extra 

🎅 Costume Contest with Prizes
🍪 Holiday treats & hot cocoa at the finish-line festival
🎶 DJ Claus spinning holiday remixes all morning
🐕 Pet donation display + “Wall of Giving” photo backdrop
🌊 Stunning Queen Mary views along the shoreline

 
🕒 Schedule of Events
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 8:00 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🏆 Awards: 9:30 AM

All finishers receive a custom medal, free race-day photos, and yummy holiday snacks — whether you’ve been naughty, nice, or somewhere in between.

 
💝 Why We Run
Because giving back feels even better than crossing the finish line.
Your donations to the Long Beach Animal Shelter help keep rescue pets warm, fed, and full of holiday hope. Every mile = a tail wag of gratitude. 🐾

 
💬 Why CaliFlow Runs
CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, affordable, and high-vibe races that bring runners and walkers of all paces together. We keep it low-key, coastal, and full of good energy — because fitness and fun should always go hand in hand.

 
🚗 Parking
Free street parking available.
Beach lot parking is $2/hour starting at 8 AM (use Passport app or pay stations).

 
📸 Finish-Line Fun
Between the Naughty & Nice Finish Arch, Santa’s Candy Cane Wall, and Elfie Stations, you’ll need your camera ready — or just keep smiling, our photographers have you covered!

 
🐾 Pet Drive Details
Donation items for the Long Beach Animal Shelter:

Dog & cat food (dry or canned)
Treats, blankets, towels
Toys, leashes, cleaning supplies


All donations will be collected at check-in and displayed at the Wall of Giving to celebrate our community’s generosity and big holiday hearts. ❤️

name: Midway Shelter Winter Run / Walk ~ 5k, 10k and Kids Run
description:
General Info - December 6th, 2025


Packet Pick up and Race Schedule:

  • December 3rd thru 5th, 2025: 10:00am - 5:00pm Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St / Alameda, Ca. 94501
  • December 6th: 
    • 7:30am ~ raceday registration opens
      8:30am ~ 10k starts
      8:45am ~ 5k starts
      9:45am ~ kids 1/2 mile run starts
      10:00am ~ 5k and 10k awards
       

Event Details: 


Join us for the annual Midway Shelter winter run. Event takes place at the Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal in Alameda on Bay Farm Island and supports a great cause. 


The run will take you along the beautiful shoreline of Bay Farm Island and is a flat out and back with views of San Francisco and the Alameda Main Island. This year we plan to utilize the streets of Harbor Bay Parkway to account for the increase in race attendance. 


The Kids run for 12 and under will be a 1/2 mile course. Kids run will start at 9:45am and will follow a circular loop out and back on the shoreline trail. There is plenty of parking at the Ferry terminal and we will have snacks and drinks when the race is over. 

Midway Shelter provides emergency shelter to homeless women and children and is operated through a partnership with Alameda Homeless Network and Building Futures – learn more about our work by checking out our two websites, below!

Founded in 1989, Midway Shelter of Alameda provides a safe and supportive environment for women and children experiencing  homelessness. By pledging any dollar amount, in addition to your registration, you can support the Midway Shelter provide a safe place for women and their children. Your donation is tax deductible as the Alameda Homeless Network operates as a 501(c)3 Tax ID number 94-3078153)

 

http://midwayshelter.org/donate.htm
www.bfwc.org
 

AC Transit Site: https://www.actransit.org/

Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/

  • December 3rd thru 5th, 2025: 10:00am - 5:00pm Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St / Alameda, Ca. 94501
  • December 6th: 
    • 7:30am ~ raceday registration opens
      8:30am ~ 10k starts
      8:45am ~ 5k starts
      9:45am ~ kids 1/2 mile run starts
      10:00am ~ 5k and 10k awards
       

Event Details: 


Join us for the annual Midway Shelter winter run. Event takes place at the Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal in Alameda on Bay Farm Island and supports a great cause. 


The run will take you along the beautiful shoreline of Bay Farm Island and is a flat out and back with views of San Francisco and the Alameda Main Island. This year we plan to utilize the streets of Harbor Bay Parkway to account for the increase in race attendance. 


The Kids run for 12 and under will be a 1/2 mile course. Kids run will start at 9:45am and will follow a circular loop out and back on the shoreline trail. There is plenty of parking at the Ferry terminal and we will have snacks and drinks when the race is over. 

Midway Shelter provides emergency shelter to homeless women and children and is operated through a partnership with Alameda Homeless Network and Building Futures – learn more about our work by checking out our two websites, below!

Founded in 1989, Midway Shelter of Alameda provides a safe and supportive environment for women and children experiencing  homelessness. By pledging any dollar amount, in addition to your registration, you can support the Midway Shelter provide a safe place for women and their children. Your donation is tax deductible as the Alameda Homeless Network operates as a 501(c)3 Tax ID number 94-3078153)

 

http://midwayshelter.org/donate.htm
www.bfwc.org

Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/

name: Mile Madness Ultra Endurance Runs
description:
Join the Ultimate Loop Adventure in the Heart of Trail Country!

Mile Madness is more than a race—it's a vibrant celebration of endurance, community, and personal triumph. Set against the stunning backdrop of Folsom, California, this looped trail event invites runners of all paces to push their limits (or simply enjoy the journey) on a meticulously designed 1-mile course that's a mix of paved bike path and dirt trail, blending rolling hills, shaded paths, river views, and scenic vistas for an unforgettable experience.

Event Details:

Dates: September 25-27, 2026

Friday: 9:00 am 72 Hour Run and 72 Hour Team Relay 6:00 pm: 48 Hour Run and 48 Hour Team Relay

Saturday: 9:00 am 100 Mile Race Noon: 12 Hour and 24 Hour 6:00 pm: 6 Hour Glow Run

Location: Folsom, CA (exact venue to be announced upon permit approval)

Race Options: Choose your challenge from 8 timed events, ranging from a beginner-friendly 6-hour run to the epic 72-hour ultra. With exceptionally long cutoffs and no strict time pressures, whether you're walking, running, or crawling, there's space for everyone to shine and even earn one of the coveted Mile Madness Buckles.

Course Highlights: A compact 1-mile loop means continuous laps with easy access to aid stations, festive decorations, and upbeat music to keep your spirits high. Aim for that first ultra milestone or chase elite goals—many of our runners discover untapped potential here.

Why Mile Madness?

Inclusivity for All: From ages 10 to 82, with a balanced mix of 52.8% male and 47.2% female participants. In 2024, we welcomed 115 runners with a remarkable 72% buckle completion rate (applies to 48- and 72-hour runners); 2025 saw 140 strong, and we're projecting 200-250 for 2026. Beginners who've never run an ultramarathon often surprise themselves with distances they never imagined.

Top-Notch Support: Fully stocked aid station featuring a rotating menu of hearty meals, electrolytes, all the typical aid station food, and endless encouragement from what might be the best volunteers in trail running. Other amenities include on-site massage therapists, family cheer zones, glow run, food trucks, and more...

Bling & Bragging Rights: Earn the coveted Silver 100-Mile Buckle (35 awarded in 2024, many to first timers!) or challenge yourself for the stunning Gold 150-Mile Buckle or the brand new 200-Mile buckle. Plus, a 100% rollover policy up to 24 hours before race start means zero risk if life throws a curveball.

SWAG: Every registered runner will get a race shirt or jacket. Our current plan is to provide gender specific packable puffy jackets. We cannot guarantee sizes for registrations after 9/1/26, but we will do our best to accommodate requests. All runners will also get other SWAG that will be announced closer to race weekend.

Family & Community Focus: Bring your crew! Our expansive 20x30 Family Cheer Zone offers shaded comfort with music, free snacks and water, games, course decorations, S’mores, and a DIY sign-making station to fuel the fun. Come solo or with friends—you'll leave with new bonds, shared stories, and memories that last a lifetime. Runners rave: "The highlight of my year!" (Summer W.) and "My favorite race ever!" (Shawnee).

Extra Perks: On-site ultra-camping for immersive weekend vibes, plenty of clean portable restrooms, and a commitment to giving back through the Run Free Foundation, supporting at-risk youth with free gear, training, and race scholarships.

Mile Madness isn't just about the miles—it's about the madness of joy, grit, and connection that turns strangers into trail family. Whether you're chasing a PR, your first buckle, or just the thrill of the loop, we're here to cheer every step. Secure your spot now and join the fun!

Questions? Email Race Director Brian Goldman at brian@everydayenduranceraces.com. Let's make 2026 your most memorable madness yet!

*While the final permit is in process, all registrations will be 100% refundable. We will have a 2026 Mile Madness at our new home.

Set against the stunning backdrop of Folsom, California, this looped trail event invites runners of all paces to push their limits (or simply enjoy the journey) on a meticulously designed 1-mile course that's a mix of paved bike path and dirt trail, blending rolling hills, shaded paths, river views, and scenic vistas for an unforgettable experience.

Event Details:

Dates: September 25-27, 2026

Friday: 9:00 am 72 Hour Run and 72 Hour Team Relay 6:00 pm: 48 Hour Run and 48 Hour Team Relay

Saturday: 9:00 am 100 Mile Race Noon: 12 Hour and 24 Hour 6:00 pm: 6 Hour Glow Run

Location: Folsom, CA (exact venue to be announced upon permit approval)

Race Options: Choose your challenge from 8 timed events, ranging from a beginner-friendly 6-hour run to the epic 72-hour ultra. With exceptionally long cutoffs and no strict time pressures, whether you're walking, running, or crawling, there's space for everyone to shine and even earn one of the coveted Mile Madness Buckles.

Course Highlights: A compact 1-mile loop means continuous laps with easy access to aid stations, festive decorations, and upbeat music to keep your spirits high. Aim for that first ultra milestone or chase elite goals—many of our runners discover untapped potential here.

Why Mile Madness?

Inclusivity for All: From ages 10 to 82, with a balanced mix of 52.8% male and 47.2% female participants. In 2024, we welcomed 115 runners with a remarkable 72% buckle completion rate (applies to 48- and 72-hour runners); 2025 saw 140 strong, and we're projecting 200-250 for 2026. Beginners who've never run an ultramarathon often surprise themselves with distances they never imagined.

Top-Notch Support: Fully stocked aid station featuring a rotating menu of hearty meals, electrolytes, all the typical aid station food, and endless encouragement from what might be the best volunteers in trail running. Other amenities include on-site massage therapists, family cheer zones, glow run, food trucks, and more...

Bling & Bragging Rights: Earn the coveted Silver 100-Mile Buckle (35 awarded in 2024, many to first timers!) or challenge yourself for the stunning Gold 150-Mile Buckle or the brand new 200-Mile buckle. Plus, a 100% rollover policy up to 24 hours before race start means zero risk if life throws a curveball.

SWAG: Every registered runner will get a race shirt or jacket. Our current plan is to provide gender specific packable puffy jackets. We cannot guarantee sizes for registrations after 9/1/26, but we will do our best to accommodate requests. All runners will also get other SWAG that will be announced closer to race weekend.

Family & Community Focus: Bring your crew! Our expansive 20x30 Family Cheer Zone offers shaded comfort with music, free snacks and water, games, course decorations, S’mores, and a DIY sign-making station to fuel the fun. Come solo or with friends—you'll leave with new bonds, shared stories, and memories that last a lifetime. Runners rave: "The highlight of my year!" (Summer W.) and "My favorite race ever!" (Shawnee).

Extra Perks: On-site ultra-camping for immersive weekend vibes, plenty of clean portable restrooms, and a commitment to giving back through the Run Free Foundation, supporting at-risk youth with free gear, training, and race scholarships.

Mile Madness isn't just about the miles—it's about the madness of joy, grit, and connection that turns strangers into trail family. Whether you're chasing a PR, your first buckle, or just the thrill of the loop, we're here to cheer every step. Secure your spot now and join the fun!

Questions? Email Race Director Brian Goldman at brian@everydayenduranceraces.com. Let's make 2026 your most memorable madness yet!

*While the final permit is in process, all registrations will be 100% refundable. We will have a 2026 Mile Madness at our new home.

name: Minarets Endurance Classic Mountain Bike Events
description: The Minarets Endurance Classic is a bike race at Tesoro Viejo for mountain bikers and gravel grinders to enjoy with family and friends. Racers can choose from a 3 or 6-hour format. If 3 or 6 hours is too long to race by yourself, put together a two to four person team. Teams will send out one rider at a time and trade off completing loops however they choose and complete as many loops as possible in the allotted time. Any team with at least one member who rides an E-Bike will race in the E-Bike category. Costume Contest for youth and adults!!

name: Mission Hills 5K
description:
The 11th Annual Mission Hills 5K — Voted San Diego’s Best 5K!

Get ready, runners! The Mission Hills 5K returns on Saturday, March 21, 2026, at 8:00 a.m., and you won’t want to miss it. Voted “San Diego’s Best 5K” by readers of San Diego Magazine, this community favorite brings families, friends, and neighbors together. Run or walk through the streets of San Diego's historic Mission Hills neighborhood!

All proceeds benefit educational programming at Grant TK-8, helping to enrich the learning experience for every student.

Registration Details

  • Early bird registration ends December 31, 2025 — sign up early and save!
  • Online registration closes March 18, 2026.
  • Register by March 7, 2026 to guarantee your official Mission Hills 5K t-shirt!

Please note that for safety reasons, pets, roller skates, and other wheeled devices are not allowed on the 5K course. Jogging strollers and race wheelchairs / Duos are permitted.

After you cross the finish line, stick around for our Finish Line Fun Fair in Pioneer Park, featuring family activities, community booths, and post-race celebrations.

Let’s make the 11th Annual Mission Hills 5K the best one yet — see you at the starting line!

name: Miwok 100K
description:
The Miwok 100K is one of the most beautiful and iconic trail ultramarathons in the world. We believe everyone deserves a shot at something extraordinary. The Miwok100K is about the everyday runner who shows up ready to dig deep on some of the most breathtaking trails around. Set in the Marin Headlands just north of San Francisco, The Miwok 100K offers 62 miles of gorgeous trails, over 11,000 feet of gain, and nonstop views, from redwoods to ridge lines to crashing coastal cliffs. 

The course features single-track trails and dirt roads with about a mile of paved road. The race is competitive at the front, and a rewarding challenge for all. Less than an hour from San Francisco, the Start/Finish is in the town of beautiful Stinson Beach, nestled against Mount Tamalpais, with its excellent cafés, a small market, lodging, and more.

Course marking is excellent, and you’ll be supported by some of the best volunteers on a race course anywhere. We hire professional medical for all aid stations for those occasional skinned knees and such. Our 2026 runners will receive a custom Miwok 100K finisher’s medal and a Miwok 100K sweatshirt.

We have 3 options for you to participate in our event:

1. Miwok 100K on May 2, 2026 (When the race is full, you will be placed on a Waitlist. Your card will not be charged until you are offered a spot, and accept it. Registered runners who drop prior to February 1 will receive a $110 (40%) refund.) 

2. Miwok 100K on May 2, 2026, PLUS a 16 week training plan from coach & Race Director Magda Boulet

3. Miwok 100K Team Relay on May 2, 2026 (must have 4 participants per relay)

Please make sure you sign up for the correct event!

description:
****Results can be found at www.paceyourselftiming.com then click on the “Events” tab


***PARK IS ON THE CORNER OF TIOGA DRIVE AND LEIGION PARK

 

WALK-IN REGISTRATIONS ONLY STARTING ON WEDNESDAY 11/26
***RACE DAY REGISTRATION RATES INCREASE ONCE PRE-REGISTRATION CLOSES, SO SIGN UP TODAY!!!

***PLEASE REMEMBER TO BRING IN CASH FOR RACE DAY SIGN UPS. VENMO IS ALSO AVAILABLE

Top 3 finishers in 5k fun run in age groups:

0-13, 14-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Overall male and female finishers will receive a medal.

There will be no official results for the Gobbler Walk, but a timer will be displayed at the separate Gobbler Walk finish line for your convenience.

Post race refreshments will be available.

T-shirts will be provided and will be guaranteed to the first 500 entrants.

name: MLK Freedom Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Join in our annual Martin Luther King Jr. Day Run! Today, we gather to honor the legacy of Dr. King and his enduring commitment to justice, equality, and peace. As we lace up our shoes and hit the pavement, let’s reflect on his powerful message of love and resilience.

This event is not just about fitness; it’s a celebration of community, a call to action for social change, and a reminder of the work still to be done. Together, we can honor Dr. King’s dream and inspire one another to continue striving for a better world. Let’s run with purpose and passion!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

This event is not just about fitness; it’s a celebration of community, a call to action for social change, and a reminder of the work still to be done. Together, we can honor Dr. King’s dream and inspire one another to continue striving for a better world. Let’s run with purpose and passion!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Modesto Marathon
description:
2026 here we come!

The Grafitti Classic Car theme will be back again with more cars and more entertainment. 

Visit our website for event details.

Our Cause

Proceeds benefit the Teens Run Modesto program, which challenges area youth, especially those at-risk, to experience the benefits of goal-setting, character development, adult mentoring, and improved physical fitness through a structured training program culminating in the running and completion of the Modesto Marathon.

name: Moorpark Groundhog Day 5k/1M
description:
Benefiting Moorpark High School’s cross country and track programs, the Groundhog Day event consists of two events. Starting at the high school, the 5k is a fast, chip timed road race with an exciting finish at the beautiful Moorpark High School stadium. All ages and abilities are welcome.  All participants age 11 and under who complete the 5k will received a finisher medal.  There will also be a “Catch the Groundhog” 1 mile fun run for kids 11 and under which will be held on the track with finisher medals for all. Registration fees include a t-shirt for all runners (shirts are only guaranteed if you register by Sunday 1/25/26).

Post-race festivities include the awards ceremony with age group medals plus refreshments, vendors, and a raffle of wonderful prizes donated by local businesses.

name: Moraga Turkey Trot-2025
description:
Please join the Moraga Chamber of Commerce on Thanksgiving morning for the annual Moraga Turkey Trot! Trot your way out to the cart path at Moraga Country Club wearing your favorite zany costume, activewear or PJs! You can push a pram, set up a run squad or saunter solo, but just be sure to bring your community spirit!

 

The morning will include “unofficial” timed 5K and 1.5m races, awards for best Thanksgiving-themed costume and speediest turkey, as well as random bib number draws to earn prizes from local businesses. Runners, walkers and lollygaggers of all ages are welcome! 

 

Advance registration is required. Unfortunately, we cannot take registrations on-site. Registrants receive a T-shirt (sizes & tees not guaranteed - see registration details), a numbered running bib and goodies, while they last! Participants will check the digital timer at START/FINISH for self-timing. Come enjoy this wholesome tradition and celebrate Thanksgiving morning together! You do not need to be a member of the Chamber or the Country Club to participate. 

 

5K - START TIME (8:10a) – Participants line up by 8am
1.5m - START TIME (8:25a) – Participants line up following the departure of 5K (8:15am)
 

--Registration day-of is *Not Available*--
Anyone on the course should be registered, bib'd and have signed the waiver.  

Parking will be limited and traffic laws enforced. Arrange for carpool, drop-offs and walking over, whenever possible. Take Care and remember to be kind to one another!

name: Morgan Hill AAUW Wildflower Run
description:
The AAUW Wildflower Run raises money for scholarships and leadership programs for women & girls and community grants. (For information about our organization, go to www.aauwmh.org.) 10K Run, 5K Run, 5K Walk, and 5K stroller/baby jogger category are all on country roads with chip timing. The Kids' 2K  Run (ages 5-11) and our "all inclusive, non-competitive" 2K Fun Run/Walk (for ages 2-102) are both on a school track.  
Our new 5K and 10K routes are in a country setting surrounding Morgan Hill with flat terrain on paved roads. Flat and fast for runners wanting to improve their personal record times. Water available at start and finish of race, with multiple water stops along the routes. Strollers are welcome everywhere except on the school's track. No pets permitted on school grounds.
NOTE: The event is an "open course", so you will need to stay to the side of the road as some vehicular traffic is expected.
Register early to be guaranteed a unique, 2026 T-shirt in your size.  In addition to your limited edition T-shirt, we offer bonus baby-T's for the stroller event (while supplies last) and themed medals for youth. See wildflowerrun.org for details.
We offer discount pricing for groups, as follows:
  • groups of 10 or more (request a $5 off per person “coupon code” for your group in advance of registering; enter the code at checkout).
  • school teams (within boundaries of MHUSD) – if your principal has agreed to sign up your school for the "school competition", your school will have a unique school "coupon code" for $5 off any race for student/family/staff; enter the code at checkout.

name: Mountains 2 Beach Marathon and Half
description: Uniquely situated and completely surrounded by beautiful mountains, the city of Ojai holds the start of the Mountains 2 Beach Marathon while the half starts closer to the beach. This point to point race winds through the Ventura River Valley as it makes its way to the pristine beaches of the last great surf town in California, Ventura. Runners will love the gradual downhill nature of the race, which is prime to make you faster but not hurt the knees, and the amazing weather of the area. After a final tour of beach front Ventura, runners and their families are treated to a finish line party only steps away from the surf and the shops and restaurants of Historic Downtown Ventura. As a certified Boston Qualifier, the courses, the race and the surrounding communities make for the perfect destination marathon and half.

name: Move4U 5K Run/Walk for Parkinson's, Dystonia, & Movement Disorders
description:
The Parkinson's and Movement Disorder Foundation (PMDF) and the National Spasmodic Torticollis Association are hosting the MOVE4U 5K Walk/Run Fundraiser at Mile Square Park in Fountain Valley, California. The proceeds will empower the PMDF and the NSTA to significantly further their mission of advancing crucial research into the causes, treatments, and cures of Parkinson's disease and other movement disorders like dystonia. Your support will improve the lives of patients and also play a vital role in raising awareness.

REGISTRATION INCLUDES

– Free hat provided for attendees

– Raffle Prizes

– Sandwiches and Cookies from Katella Deli in Los Alamitos

– Water

 

5K Run Top Three Prizes

1st place prize $300

2nd place prize $ $200

3rd place prize $100

name: MVRRC 12th Annual Jingle Bell 5k Run & kids 1 mile race
description:
Moreno Valley Road Runners Club will be celebrating our 12th annual Jingle Bell fun run at Lake Perris State Recreation Area, Dam 17801 Lake Perris Drive, Perris, CA 92571. On December 13, 2025, at 7:30 am.

What: Don’t miss Southern California’s best Jingle Bell tradition! Run/walk a 5K before you open gifts. There will be a 1-mile kids' race (ages 12 and under). Everyone is welcome!

Where: Enjoy a historic course along the Dam, referred to as The Lake Perris Dam. You’ll pass by such a notable lake. What a great way to see the beautiful lake in the morning.

Course: The race starts and finishes at the Dam Area. This is a flat, long course with no traffic.

When: December 13, 2025, at 7:30 am. Packet pick up on race day only.

Race Start Times: The kids’ 1-mile race starts at 8:15 AM, and the 5K starts at 8:30 AM.

Awards: Top 3 boys and girls in the 1-mile race, Top 3 open Males and Females in the 5K.

Prizes: Medals will be given to all participants. The first 50 sign-ups will receive a t-shirt.

Fees: The kids' one-mile race is $5.00, the 5-K race is $20.00. All payments are the same on race day. We take cash, Venmo, the Cash app, and Zelle on race day. The entrance to the park will be $10.00.

For more information, don't hesitate to get in touch with Race Director Henry at mvrrc@hotmail.com or via text at 951-396-5896

MVRRC would like all participants to donate any open gifts for the children in need for Christmas. Thank you.

Instructions on how to get to the Jingle Bell Race at Lake Perris, from the Perris side, after you pass security, you want to make a right on Alta Calle, the first entrance before lot number one. From the Moreno Valley side, you want to drive till you pass Lot Number One. Once you pass the lot, you want to make a left on Alta Calle before the exit on the Perris side.

name: Nail the Rail Half Marathon, 10K & 5K
description:
Join us for a stroll along the Sacramento Rail Trail.  A converted Southern Pacific Railroad track that starts at the base of Shasta Dam and runs for over 11 miles.

Enjoy a the view along the Sacramento River/Keswick Lake in the cool of the morning.  Trail is very flat and fast.

Field is limited to 350.

Races include a half marathon, 10K and 5K.

Finisher awards to Half marathoners.  Awards 3 deep in age groups, plus overall awards.

Start/Finish will be from the Chappie OHV area at the base of Shasta Dam.  Once you cross Shasta Dam you will follow the road down to the OHV area.

Race day registration and packet pickup opens at 7am at OHV area.

Packet pickup and registration on Friday the 25th from 11am to 3pm at Redding Fleet Feet Store at 1376 Hilltop Dr.

Start times:

Half Marathon - 8am

5K & 10K - 8:15am

Cutoff time of 3hrs 30 minutes for half-marathon.

name: Napa Valley Turkey Chase
description:
Welcome to the Turkey Chase, Napa's only Thanksgiving Day 5K/10K! 

The Napa Valley Turkey Chase is a fun family event! Race, jog or walk this fast, paved course around the Napa Valley College and the Napa River Trail and work up your Thanksgiving appetite!

The start & finish line are located in lot J behind the Napa Valley College track. Lot J will also be the staging area for packet pick-up, day of race registration, booths and toilets. There is NO PARKING in lot J .

PLEASE NOTE: THERE ARE COURSE CHANGES THIS YEAR!

The 10K course runs a counterclockwise loop through the college and then meets the Napa River Trail. Runners will go north to a turn around under the Imola bridge near mile 2. Then they will run south to Kennedy Park where the course makes a small counterclockwise loop near the skate park and then retraces the route back up the river trail. The 10K course then meets back up with the 5K by the baseball field and finishes back in lot J.

name: Napa Valley Turkey Chase
description:
Welcome to the Turkey Chase, Napa's only Thanksgiving Day 5K/10K! 

The Napa Valley Turkey Chase is a fun family event! Race, jog or walk this fast, paved course around the Napa Valley College and the Napa River Trail and work up your Thanksgiving appetite!

The start & finish line are located in lot J behind the Napa Valley College track. Lot J will also be the staging area for packet pick-up, day of race registration, booths and toilets. There is NO PARKING in lot J .

PLEASE NOTE: THERE ARE COURSE CHANGES THIS YEAR!

The 10K course runs a counterclockwise loop through the college and then meets the Napa River Trail. Runners will go north to a turn around under the Imola bridge near mile 2. Then they will run south to Kennedy Park where the course makes a small counterclockwise loop near the skate park and then retraces the route back up the river trail. The 10K course then meets back up with the 5K by the baseball field and finishes back in lot J.

The 5K course runs the same counterclockwise loop through the college and then connects to the Napa River Trail. Runners will immediately proceed south past mile 2 and turn at the baseball field to head to the finish back in lot J. Both courses have been measured by wheel and GPS, but it is not a USATF certified course.

name: Navy Ten-Miler
description:
Run with Honor. Endure with Courage. Finish with Commitment.

The Navy Ten-Miler brings together athletes, service members, veterans, and civilians to honor the Navy’s core values of Honor, Courage, and Commitment. Whether you're a seasoned runner or searching for your next challenge, this is your call to RUN NAVY.

Navy Races are more than a finish line. They celebrate the strength, resilience, and unity of our community. Proceeds benefit Navy Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) programs that enhance the lives of Sailors and their families.

Key Benefits:

  • Support Navy personnel and families
  • Run along San Diego Bay’s iconic waterfront
  • Experience naval history and patriotism
  • Connect with the veteran and civilian running community
  • Be part of a race with purpose and impact

Who Can Participate?

Everyone is welcome. Whether you are active duty, a veteran, a military family member, or a civilian who wants to support a meaningful cause, Navy Race events are open to all fitness levels.

Join a race with purpose.

name: Nelson Family Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18, 2026 at 11:00am for a super fun annual event that features the amazing hospitality and scenery of Nelson Family Vineyards! For 70 years the Nelson family has farmed the land they live on, with the traditions of farming passed on to four generations. Through many seasons of tending and harvest, Nelson Family Vineyards has embraced the truth that great wines are born in the vineyard. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: New Year New Me Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎉 Start Your Year on the Right Foot! 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️
Join the New Year New Me Run - New Beginnings Starts Today!

Kick off the new year with energy, excitement, and a community of runners ready to chase their goals. Whether you're a seasoned racer or just starting out, this run is for YOU!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)

https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/

- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal!
