name: Rose Bowl Turkey Trot
description:
We are back for the 8th annual Rose Bowl Turkey Trot, a family favorite tradition 5k race on Thanksgiving morning around the Rose Bowl Stadium. All are invited whether you have two legs or four! All entry fees for 2025 will be 100% tax-deductible and will go directly to the Rose Bowl Legacy Foundation. Trot before you gobble and help preserve, protect, and enhance the Rose Bowl Stadium! To learn more about the Rose Bowl Legacy Foundation, visit https://www.rosebowllegacy.org.

Each participant will have an opportunity to donate after checkout. This year, the Rose Bowl Stadium is partnering with Pasadena Unified School District through the Pasadena Educational Foundation Eaton Fire Response. This effort will provide financial support to assist with the financial impacts associated from the recent Eaton Fire. 

The race is on Thanksgiving morning at the Rose Bowl Stadium! A timed race will go through a 3.1-mile course. All participants will receive a race bib and medal. The race will start and finish at the top of Lot K. The course itself will run around the Rose Bowl Loop. On race day bib pickup will begin at 6:30 AM. We highly encourage you to pick up your bib in advance on Wednesday, November 26th from 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM in Lot K at the Rose Bowl Stadium.  

Reminder: This race is all ages and children under the age of 12 must be accompanied by a registered parent/legal guardian at all times. 

Don’t forget to post photos of your trot and tag @rosebowlstadium and @rosebowllegacy and use hashtag #RoseBowlTurkeyTrot

 

FAQs:

Q: What does my registration include? 

A: Your registration includes access to the onsite race, a race bib, finishers medal. 100% of your ticket registration is tax deductible and goes towards the Rose Bowl Legacy Foundation. 

Q: What time does the race start?

A: The race begins promptly at 8:30AM. 

Q: How old do I need to be to participate?

A: Trotters can participate at all ages! 

Q: Where will the start line and registration table be?

A: In Lot K on the corner of West Dr. and Seco St. 

Q: Where do I park, and do I have to pay?

A: Parking will be free and in Lot K.

Q: Can I bring pets to the race?

A: Yes! You may bring dogs as long as they are on a leash.

Q: Will there be water stations?

A: Yes, a water station will be set-up halfway around the route, but we suggest you bring your own water as well.

Q: Will the event be rain or shine?

A: Yes, it will be rain or shine but hopefully shine 😊

Q: Should I wear a costume? 

A: Yes, costumes are highly encouraged to get into the Thanksgiving spirit!

Q: I have a small child. Can I race with a stroller? 

A: Yes! In the spirit of family involvement strollers are encouraged! We kindly ask participants with strollers to allow other racers to pass safely. 

Q: Can I come to packet pickup and gather someone else's packet for them?

A: Yes.

name: Rotary Mission Ten - Half Marathon, 10 Mile and 5K
description:
Race Day Registration and Packet/Bib pickup begins at 7:15am on January 31st, 2026

This event is in its 42nd year. It is sponsored by the Rotary Club of Hollister and all proceeds go to benefit local scholarships and charities. San Juan Bautista is a small California Mission town just off Hwy 101 approximately 50 miles south of San Jose. The four races: 1/2 marathon, 10 miles, 5k and 1 Mile kids fun run, all start and finish in front of the historic and beautiful San Juan Mission. The area is rural and the course takes runners through farm land and up the Anzar hills. Medals are awarded three deep in standard age categories. The 1/2 marathon (USATF cerfitied)  and 10 mile races  are particularly good training for upcoming spring marathons. Theme teams encouraged and trophies will be awarded to top teams. (Please keep costumes family friendly)

Fees include Long sleeve dri-tech t-shirt and finisher medal. Great training for marathon base. All races except fun run timed w/awards.



2026 Mission 10 Race Day Frequently Asked Questions & info

 

Race Day Registration, Check in & Bib Pickup:

7:15am at Mission lawn


Shirt Pickup:

7:15am at Mission lawn after check-in. 


Race Times:

8:15am - Half Marathon

8:30am - Kid’s 1 Mile Fun Run

9:00am - Ten Mile

9:15am - 5k


Race Day Prices:

Half Marathon - $70

Ten Mile - $60

5k - $45

1 Mile Fun Run - $15 


Theme Team Check in and Awards:

7:15 am – 8:00am: Registration and group entry photos.

8:30 am – Trophies Awarded to top 3 teams and winner photos taken.


Changing of Races:

Need to change from one race to another? You can do that on our registration page at mission10.com or ask for Bill Tiffany at check in on race day. 

Parking:

Street parking is available around the Mission and adjacent streets in San Juan. There is also parking available at San Juan Elementary School parking lot and adjacent field at the Alameda.


Water Stations:

Refillable water bottle station at Mission lawn. Standard water stations with paper cups along all courses.


Bathrooms:

Portables located at start/finish across from the Mission. One bathroom around the 3.5 mile from start/finish area for participants. One bathroom located by the old Mission Jail near the start/finish.


Strollers:

Families with strollers welcome in all races.


Dogs:

Well behaved dogs are welcome to run with their humans.


Medal Pickup:

Please pickup medals at the medal table after completing your race just past the finish line.


Finisher Times & Race Awards:

Finishing times will be available online at Mission10.com under RESULTS

name: Ruff Run California
description:
Join Us here for our annual obstacle run designed for people and their pups! Over 20 obstacles and growing every year- this course will test your training, your bond and your willingness to just let loose and have great time! This 20 acre course is more than just getting dirty!!! Our obstacles range from mud and water to thinking and strategy to test your bond with your pup!! Are you a team??Every year we add more challenges!  After party with music, games and vendors! Come spend the day in the beautiful high desert at 4200 ft above sea level! 

Follow our Facebook page Ruff Run California for all the info and details as well as pics from the last event!

name: Run Against Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎀 Join the Against Breast Cancer Run! 🎀 

Lace up and make a difference at our Against Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 

Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 
Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Run by the Sea
description:
Run by the Sea returns to lovely Wilder Ranch State Park on Sunday, October 4th! This unique Half Marathon, 12K run, and 4K run/walk meanders along the gorgeous coastal bluffs of California's Central Coast in Santa Cruz and consists mostly of flat, packed dirt trails. Participants will enjoy scenic coastal views while passing along the bluffs and Wilder Ranch park trails. Get ready to take in the natural beauty of the Monterey Bay, the serene flats of Wilder Ranch's meadows, and maybe even catch a glimpse of some dolphins - no other race is quite like it!

Now in its 101h year, Run by the Sea is organized by the Santa Cruz Track Club and benefits the track club's youth program, Bike Santa Cruz County, and Santa Cruz Mountain Trail Stewards.

name: Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K
description:
Join us for the 8th running of Run Deo Run as we raise funds for LAFR's Track program.  Run Deo Run Turkey Trot features a flat 5K on the trails of Griffith Park. 

Location & Date
Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K will be on Sunday, November 30, in Griffith Park. The start/finish area is the Pecan Grove Picnic Area near the LA Zoo/Autry Museum.  The 5K is a mostly flat out and back course along the main trail.

Start Time
Run Deo Run Turkey Trot 5K will start at 8:00 AM.

Virtual Race
If you can't join us race day, please join us by registering for the virtual option.  We will ship your race shirt/medal.

5K Awards
Awards will be given to the top 3 overall in the 5K. Age group awards for the 5K are top 3 in the following categories: 10 & Under, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80+. 

More Race Info & Past Results
For more race info including course maps, past results and course records, please click HERE.

About LA Frontrunners
Los Angeles Frontrunners (501c3) is a running and walking club for members and friends of the LGBTQ+ community.  In addition to running, walking, more running (and lots of eating), LAFR raises funds and collects goods to donate to local charities. Past beneficiaries include; The Rescue Train, Westside Food Bank, SRLA, PAWS/LA, Life Worth Saving, Friends of Griffith Park, InsideOut Community Arts, Friends of Project 10, Angel City Pit Bulls, The Breakfast Club at St. Thomas the Apostle, and the Don Thompson Scholarship at the USC Film School.

name: Run for a Claus presented by Optima Tax Relief
description:
The OC Marathon Presents the 12th Annual Run For a Claus 5K and Kids 1 Mile Run/Walk benefiting various charity partners as well as our own Kids Run the OC Foundation. All runners will receive a commemorative 2025 giveaway, Santa Hat, a finisher's medal and free race photos. With cookies, costumes, holiday music and decorations, this will be fun for the whole family.

When you Run for a Claus, you can Run for a Cause!

name: Run for Austin's Lungs
description:
Run for Austin’s Lungs is a family-friendly 5K walk/run held in honor of baby Austin, who is bravely battling chronic lung disease. Join us to celebrate his first birthday, raise awareness of his Chronic Lung disease, and support his ongoing medical care. Every step taken helps give Austin the breath of a brighter future.

The entire registration fee (minus the $4 processing fee) goes directly to Austin’s care. After you register, the site will ask if you’d like to make an additional donation—this can simply be left at $0, meaning your total charge will be $54 for race registration.

If you’d prefer to support Austin without registering for the race, you can do so by selecting the Donate button instead of Sign Up.

name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀

Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 

Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Join Us for the Sweetest Run of the Year – The Chocolate Run!

Lace up your running shoes and bring your sweet tooth—because this isn’t your average race.

It’s a deliciously fun event for all ages and fitness levels!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ ☕️ 🏃‍♂️ 

For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! The first 5 runners, we'll send you some coffee.  😊 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

For all the Coffee Lovers, this run is for you! You’ll love the shirt we send you. Set a goal, bring a friend, and join this super fun 5K/10K/13.1 Half-Marathon! The first 5 runners, we'll send you some coffee.  😊 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

🍩🏃‍♂️🍩🏃‍♂️🍩🏃‍♂️

Running for donuts is worth the pain.  You'll get a run for donuts shirt to show off what you run for.  

Get ready for a sweet race! Gather your friends and lace up for our annual Donut Run, where you’ll run a beautiful course and be greeted at the Finish Line with... donuts!  Enjoy a fun-filled day of running, laughter, and Community. 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Join us for the Keep Going Run for Mental Health – a powerful event to raise awareness, help reduce stigma and start conversations around mental well-being.  Support those who need it most, while improving your own mental health through the joy of movement.

Let's break the silence.  Let's keep going.  Let's make a difference.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: RUN FOR PIE 2025
description:
NOVEMBER 27th, 2025

Sponsored by: Brooks Running & Beckmann's

Come join us on Thanksgiving morning for our 13th annual Thanksgiving Day race! Run For Pie has become one of Santa Cruz County's favorite holiday traditions. Bring the whole family (or your pet turkey) out to run or walk a 5K. Run for Pie also includes a 1/2 mile Turkey Chase Race for kids. All participants get a slice of pumpkin pie at the finish. This event will benefit the Second Harvest Food Bank and the Soquel High School Track Team. With the high demand for this race every year, we have decided to cap registrations, so be sure to register your friends and family before our race sells out! 

Kids 1/2 Mile: All proceeds from this race will go to Second Harvest Food Bank. We are hoping to donate over 12,000 meals this year!

How to register for the Pie Mile Relay: The relay will consist of 4 individuals and each individual will need to register. When you are registering for this specific race, place your first name and next to your last name place your team name. This way we can keep track of full teams. 

Packet Pick Up: 

For a smoother and more enjoyable Thanksgiving morning, we strongly recommend picking up your race bib and shirt ahead of time. Here are the available dates and times for packet pickup:

Tuesday, November 25th (Fleet Feet Aptos): 3:00 pm - 7:00 pm

Wednesday, November 26th (Fleet Feet Aptos): 10:00 am - 5:00 pm 

RACE MORNING- Thursday, November 27th (Soquel High School): 7:40 am - 8:20 am

 

Race Start Times: 

Kids 1/2 Mile: 8:35 am 

5k Start Time: 9:05 am 

Pie Mile Relay Start Time: 10:15 am 

 

🎉 Exciting Event Highlights! 🎉

☕ FREE Coffee!
The first 400 participants will receive a FREE cup of coffee provided by The Loft Coffee – don’t miss out!

🎨 Kids' Coloring Station
Let your little ones get creative at our Kids Coloring Station, brought to you by The Art Factory.

📸 FREE Photo Booth Fun
Capture unforgettable moments with family and friends at our FREE Photo Booth – memories you’ll treasure!

Come join the fun — there's something for everyone!

Price Increase Dates:

September - November 24th: $45

name: RUN FOR RUSS
description:
Come out and join us at the annual “Run For Russ” 5K Run and Community Walk on Saturday, February 7, 2026. This event serves as a tribute to honor the memory of fallen Chino Police Officer Russ Miller who was killed in the line of duty by a drunk driver on February 1, 2000. We expect over 1,000 attendees this year and would like to invite you, your family and friends to show their support by participating in this great community event. All proceeds from the event go toward the Chino Police Officers Foundation which provides assistance to youth, individuals, and organizations within the city of Chino that are in need of financial assistance. For more information and history about our event and organization click HERE.


Registration includes event t-shirt, water, snacks and a pancake breakfast provided by the Chino Kiwanis Club.

name: Run for the Beads - Mardi Gras Run 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
🎭 Run for the Beads: Mardi Gras 5K • 10K • Half Marathon
📍 5100 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 – Granada Beach
📅 Sunday, February 15th
✨ Let the Good Times Run! 

 
💜 Event Overview


Get ready to let the good times roll at the Run for the Beads!
This Mardi Gras-themed celebration brings the color, energy, and spirit of the season straight to the beach. Whether you’re chasing a new PR or just running (or walking!) for the fun of it, you’ll enjoy a vibrant course, festive music, and beads galore!

So grab your friends, dress in purple, green, and gold, and join us for miles of smiles, energy, and coastal charm.

 
💚 Event Highlights
🎷 Beads & Bling: Snag your Mardi Gras beads as you dash along the course!
🎶 Finish Line Festival: Celebrate your finish with live music, festive treats, and of course — King Cake!
📸 Epic Photo Ops: Pose with colorful backdrops featuring crowns, masks, and beads for your perfect race-day shot.
🎊 Festive Atmosphere: Music, decorations, and energy that make every mile feel like a parade!
🏅 Finisher Medals: Every participant earns a  finisher medal!

💧 Bead & Water Stations: Stay hydrated and keep the beads flowing every 2 miles!
🎭 Costume Contest: Show your Mardi Gras flair — prizes for Most Festive, Best Group, and Wildest Spirit!

 
💛 CaliFlow Experience


🌊 Professional Chip Timing – Accurate results for all distances
🎶 Live DJ & Finish Line Festival – Music, celebration, and good vibes
📷 Free Race Day Photos – Capture your Mardi Gras magic
🥇 Overall & Age Group Awards – Celebrate your speed (and style!)
👟 Stroller & Walker Friendly – Everyone’s welcome to roll, run, or stroll
🏁 Fully Marked Coastal Course – Flat, fast, and full of fun energy

 
🕕 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
📦 Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM to  7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
🏁 Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 7:30 AM
⚠️ No late starts — make sure you’re ready to roll when the beads start flying!

 
🛍️ Pre-Race Packet Pick-Up
📍 Lululemon – 6460 E Pacific Coast Hwy, Unit 115, Long Beach, CA 90803
🕓 Thursday | February 12th 4 PM to 7 PM
Free 90-min garage parking (bring ID if picking up for someone else).

 
🚗 Event Day Parking Information
🅿️ Beach lot parking available – rates  $2:00 Per Hour
💳 Pay at the machine or use Passport APP

 
☀️ Weather & Safety
This is a RAIN or SHINE event — because Mardi Gras doesn’t cancel for clouds!
(Only postponed for tidal waves, tsunamis, or zombie parades 🧟‍♀️🎭 — we’ll notify you by email if that happens.)

 
🎉 Join the Movement
Tag your moments with @CaliFlowRuns and #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!
Follow us for weekly giveaways and #FreeEntryFriday fun.

 
🎭✨ Run. Revel. Repeat.
Let the beads fly and the good times roll — only with CaliFlow Runs!

name: Run for the Planet - Earth Day  5K, 10K, and Half Marathon
description:
Run for the Planet – Earth Day Celebration
🌎 Long  Beach – Alamitos Beach
📅 April 19, 2025
🏃 5K | 10K | Half Marathon

Celebrate Earth Day with us at the Run for the Planet at beautiful Alamitos Beach! This event isn’t just about running—it’s about taking action to protect our planet while enjoying the stunning California coastline.

🌱 What’s Included?
✅ Finisher Medal – A unique Earth Day-themed medal for all finishers.
✅ Sustainable Race Shirt – Made from natural fibers, 100% non-toxic, utilizing organic, water-based, and plant-based ingredients. (Shirt reveal coming soon!)
✅ Chip-Timed Event – Accurate timing for all runners.
✅ Age Division Awards – Celebrate your achievement!
✅ Top 3 Overall Male & Female Awards – For each race distance.

🌊 Giving Back to the Ocean
We are proud to support the Surfrider Foundation, an organization dedicated to the protection and enjoyment of the world’s oceans, waves, and beaches through a powerful activist network.

💙 How We’re Making a Difference:
🌊 Accepting Donations for Surfrider Foundation during registration .
🌍 Donating a portion of proceeds to help keep our oceans clean.

♻️ Eco-Friendly Efforts:

Encouraging cup-free racing – bring your reusable bottle!
Supporting zero waste initiatives at the event.
Promoting green racing with sustainable swag.
🌿 Breathe in the ocean air, run for a cause, and be part of the movement to protect our planet!

💚 Join us and Run for the Planet! 🌍🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

name: Run for the Planet – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a thrilling celebration of loving our planet, environmental stewardship, and movement!

Details
Start Location: Long Beach Location TBD
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course
Course TBD 

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details
Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, San Diego, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details
Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

description:

Sunday, Dec. 28, 2025

  • 8:00 am Half Marathon Start

  • 8:15 am Kid's Dash

  • 8:30 am 5k/10K Mass Start

Early Packet Pick-Up: We encourage you to pick up the day prior

    • Date & Time: Saturday, December 27th, 11am to 2pm

    • Location: Road Runner Sports in Newport Beach 1835 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA 92627

    • Packet pick-up is optional, so if you cannot make it- don't worry. Packets can be picked up on race day starting at 7 am in LOT 25. The gates to the STATE PARK open at 6 am.

Write a New Year resolution on the back of your bib and RUN, JOG, or WALK it into the new year. 

The course is the flat and fast, paved, wide State Park path, watching and listening to the surf.! Whether an avid runner, jogger, first-timer, or walker, we are the something for every BODY & EVERYBODY best-themed race! Bring family and friends, or just yourself and shoes! Let's get 2024 off and  RUNNING. 

  Entry comes with a Run In The New Year CUSTOM 5K/10K T-Shirt

  Special LONG SLEEVE DESIGN T-shirt for Half Marathon Finishers

  And, a huge CUSTOM CAST finisher medal to all! HUGE!!

Make it a Post-race 5K/10K resolution party (Beach balls, New Year's Beanies, & party Champaign glasses will be for sale at the t-shirt table.

GEAR CHECK is available, if needed, at the Caren Ware Events BOOTH.  Put your bib number on a tag and pin to your gear.  

Professionally CHIP timed event by ITZ ABOUT TIME. Age division awards galore!

Entrance to Bolsa Chica State Park.

The event is in the farthest western lot- Lot 25, closest to Warner & PCH, but to enter the park use the following address: 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy.
**BRING $15 CASH (or a park pass) to make the gate line proceed quickly.  Credit cards slow the process.

FREE OR METERED PARKING: There is also parking behind the Jack and the Box (corner of Warner and PCH ) and an easy walk in.  DO NOT PARK in the shopping lot or at the gas station.

Race Day Schedule:

  • 6:00 am: Gates Open
  • 7:00 am: Race Day Packet Pick-Up Begins (Lot 25)
  • 7:30 am Half Marathon Start for those that will take more than 3 hours and 45 minutes to finish
  • 8:00 am: Half Marathon Start (Must cross the starting arch by 8:05 am)
  • 8:15 am: Kid’s Dash
  • 8:30am: 5K/10K Mass Start (Must cross the starting arch by 9:05 am)
  • 9:00am: 5K Awards Ceremony begins.
  • 9:30 am 10K awards
  • 9:50 announcing of overall Half marathon awards
  • Half marathon age division winners can pick up division awards at the table or wait until the 10:15 age division announcements. 

SPECIAL PANCAKE BREAKFAST!!!!  The famous KIWANIS pineapple/coconut pancakes at this EVENT!!!  $5 pre. $6 on race morning.  You can add pancakes to your registration on the last page.Plus, COFFEE . Visit the SOL Y LUNA  COFFEE BAR CART, Fresh baked cookies (GALLETINAS BOOTH),  fresh cut fruits,  and street tacos will be there.
BRING EXTRA MONEY FOR ACAI BOWLS!!!  Fresh made at the Acai Republic booth. 

8:00 am start for HALF MARATHON.  You have until 8:05 to pass under the arch.  9:00am start for 5k/10K.  You have until 9:05 am to pass under the arch.  All 5k/10K must start before the lead half marathoner finishes.   YOUR START TIME does not start until you cross under the arch. Fastest runners in the front, and those looking to place in their age group division. Wear your bib on the front.  Make sure you run the distance on your bib or exchange it for the correct one of your choice at the Solutions/Late registration table if you decide to change races.

Awards:

There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5 year age spans: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84 and 85 & over.

Course

Flat and fast, or slow and easy, make it the pace you want it. This 5K/10K course runs along the beach bike path at Bolsa Chica, Huntington Beach State Beach. Families can bring strollers but agree to use at their own risk.  Half Marathon Course: Flat, fast, perfect for PRs or training for your next marathon.  It is (2)Two loops of the 10k so you get plenty of aid stations, entertainment, and spectator friendly!! Aid Station Every 1.5 Miles

  • Water/Gatorade
  • Chargel/ Bananas  

FLAT!!! Great for first-time Half Marathoners or those wanting to PR!
Half Marathon Spectators - you can be at the finish line to see runners start then walk about 50 ft towards the runners to see them go on their second loop.

Restrooms:

Restrooms on RACE DAY: are located at each end of the parking lot.  A set by Sea Legs (east) and a set near  Warner Blvd on the west end of the parking lot.

name: Run into Summer Vibes 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
Run into  Summer Vibes 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon – Venice Beach 🌞🌴🏃‍♀️


Get ready to soak up the sunshine and feel the energy of summer at the Summer Vibes Run in beautiful Santa Monica! Whether you’re chasing a personal best or strolling along the beach with friends, this event is all about good vibes, scenic views, and a day of fun under the California sun. Choose from the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and join the celebration!

📍 Location: World Famous Muscle Beach – 1 Windward Ace, Venice Beach, CA 
📅 Date: Saturday, May 31, 2025


 ☀️ Run into Summer Vibes – May 31st | Venice Beach, CA
Start your summer the CaliFlow way—with sunshine, good vibes, and a run down the iconic Venice Pier!

Choose from a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and soak in the beach views, palm-lined paths, and that fresh ocean breeze. Run, walk, vibe—it’s your miles, your pace.


 
🏅 What You Get:
✔  Finisher Medal for all participants
📸 Free Race Day Photos – Capture your CaliFlow moment!
🎶 Live DJ & Music at the finish line
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations along the course
 
⏰ Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent
🕠 Bib Pick-Up: 5:30 AM to 6:15 AM 
🏁 Half Marathon Start - 6:15 AM
🏁 5K 10K Start : 7:15 AM
🕠 Bib Pick-Up: 6:45 AM to 7:30 AM for 3rd Wave Runners

 
🌊 Additional Race Day Info:
✔ Restrooms near the start line
✔ Water & aid stations at both U-turn locations
✔ Stroller & walker-friendly event
✔ Fully marked course
 
☀️ Weather & Safety:
🎭 Rain or Shine Event!
🌊 Extreme weather? (Tsunamis, tidal waves, or zombie apocalypses) – updates will be sent via email & social media.
 
Plenty of free street parking early in the morning. Public parking is available at the City Lot (2100 Ocean Front Walk)—opens at 6 AM. All-day rates range from $5 to $9. 3 to 4 min walk to start line
 
🏃‍♂️ Don’t Miss This One!
Whether you’re chasing a PR, soaking in the Venice Beach vibes, or just here for the full moon magic & leprechaun fun—this race is THE PLACE TO BE! 🌕🍀
👟 Ready to run? Let’s GO! 💨🔥

name: Run Like a Hero: 4th of July 5k
description:
Join us for a 4th of July celebration, the Run Like a Hero 5k presented by Chico Striders and Chico Running Club. Race proceeds benefit Chico Striders Run Strong Scholarship presented to graduating high school senior athletes. Our theme this year is Run Like a Hero- wear your favorite hero costume or best Independence Day attire!

Date: Saturday July 4th, 2026 @ 7:30am
Registration: Will be available until 11:30pm on July 3rd. No race day registration is available.
Location: Sycamore Field, Bidwell Park - (Google Map)
Parking: At Vallombrosa Way, CARD HQ parking lot on Vallombrosa Ave or Woodland Ave

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Thursday July 3rd between 11am-1pm. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Sycamore Field, starting at 7:00am. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Discounted Registration: Chico Striders and Chico Running Club Members receive $10 off race registration, select the Striders/CRC option Team option. For non members please select No Team. Please do not register for the discounted race fee if you are not a running club member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

name: Run Like It's Recess 5K
description:
Join us for the 14th Annual Run Like It’s Recess 5K Run/Walk, 1K, and Toddler Run

​

5K Start Time: 9 am

1K Start Time: 10:15 am

Toddler Run Start Time: 10:45

​

This annual event is hosted by Newcomb Academy PTSA, which serves Newcomb Academy (Grades K–8), a public school in the Long Beach Unified School District.  
A school fundraiser and a way to promote health and fitness to the entire area. This family-friendly event is open to all ages and fitness levels. Stroller and wheelchair friendly.  

​

​

​

Medals will be given to all finishers with awards for the top three 5K finishers in each age group. FREE shirt and goody bag guaranteed if registered by January 7th, 2026 at 11:59 pm, after that date your shirt may not be available.


The Course: Flat, fast, and scenic. It takes place at El Dorado Park East in Long Beach, near the train and playground area. If you’re looking to set a personal record or if you just want to take it easy and take in the scenery, this is the perfect course.

description:
RUN RUN RUDOLPH BENEFITS HANFORD'S POLICE ACTIVITIES LEAGUE - PAL

 

Register Now and experience the BEST 2 Mile Christmas Run/Walk around, it's a Winter Wonderland in Hanford!

name: Run Through the Pines | 5K and 10K
description:
This will be the 47th Run Through the Pines

Save the date and please follow us on our Run Through the Pines Facebook and Instagram page.

The Run Through the Pines is a destination run and a San Bernardino, Rim Mountain Community Event. It is one of the longest "running" runs in Southern California (the first one was in 1979). It features a 10K and 5K run (or walk) around Lake Gregory and through a pine tree forest.  Runners (and walkers) can enjoy a semi-paved course at a 4,720-foot elevation, which makes it a perfect little challenge for mountain locals and especially our friends from down the hill. Race day staging is at the San Moritz Lodge “Meadow” area near the Lake Gregory Company bait and tackle shop. We encourage participants of all levels, children in strollers, pets on a leash, and especially teams/groups.

Lake Gregory is located in Crestline, a charming little town filled with one-of-a-kind shops and restaurants. We encourage all runners to stay the weekend and enjoy the town.

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org. 

Featured Events:

10K

5K

 

Registration

We prefer all participants pre-register online for a quicker check-in on the day of the run. Participants may also register on the day of the run. Same-day registration will be open onsite from 6:30 am on August 8.

Registration Dates & Fees: 

Until April 30 - $40 per participant 

May 1 - August 7 - $50 per participant 

Same Day Registration (August 8) - $60 per participant 

Run T-shirts are not included in registration fee. T-shirts are $20 per shirt. 

Timing & Awards 

RFID CHIP TIMED by ITZ ABOUT TIME  Top three overall trophies and age division awards 3 deep in the following categories: 10 & under, 11-14, 15-19. 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80 plus. 

Tentative Schedule of Run Day

6:30 AM     Check-in / Same day Registration

8:00 AM    10K Start

8:30 AM 5K Start

9:30 AM    Awards

Additional Features:

Music, water, post refreshments. 

Sponsors  

The Run Through the Pines is a mountain community event hosted by the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District and the Lake Gregory Company. The run relies on sponsors and/or local businesses and organizations to enhance the runner's experience on race day. If you would like more information on how to become a sponsor, please call the Park District Office, (909) 337-7275. 

Volunteers 

We love our volunteers and honestly, the event couldn't happen without them! We are currently looking for Registration and Race Kit Pick-up volunteers, Water Station Volunteers, Start/Finish Line Volunteers, and lots of course marshals to ensure a safe and fun event for everyone. Contact the Park District Office if you would like to volunteer. 

Parking

Parking is offered onsite at the San Moritz Lodge and in Lake Gregory parking lots. Please do not park directly in the Crest Forest Senior Citizens parking area or near their building, you will be towed. 

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org.

name: Run to FosterHope
description:
FosterHope Sacramento Presents its 5th Annual Run to FosterHope!


Saturday, June 13th  @ William Land Park

Join us at FosterHope Sacramento's 5th Annual Run to FosterHope on Saturday, June 13th, to support our community-based programs that help stabilize and support children and youth in crisis, while providing hope for a better future. Our 5th Annual Run to FosterHope is the perfect opportunity for us to celebrate our 40th anniversary of providing hope and healing in our community! 

 

We're excited to bring back our 5k and free kids run! Scheduled on Saturday, June 13th in beautiful Land Park in Sacramento to celebrate 40 years of FosterHope! Enjoy a beautiful day at the park while helping youth in your community! 

 

The 5K course is flat and will utilize the trails in William Land Park located next to Fairytale Town, Funderland, and the Sacramento Zoo, making it an ideal route for runners and walkers. 

 

There will also be vendors, food trucks, info booths, and kids activities -  Making a fun event for everyone. All paid registrations will receive a T-Shirt and Finishing Medal. (late registrations are not guaranteed a T-shirt on race day). Join us for a day dedicated to Fostering Hope!

 

Race Day Schedule

Registration/ Packet Pickup:  7:30 am - 8:20 am

3k/5k Race Begins: 8:30 am 

Kids Fun Run Dash:  9:45 am 

Family Fun Festival:  10 am - 1pm

During the Family Fun Festival we will host a raffle for some amazing prizes and be joined by some amazing vendors! 

 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the race timed?

A: Yes, with chipping and timing run by A Change of Pace!

 

Q: Can I run with a stroller?

A: Yes, and we’ll have activities and games for the whole family to enjoy after the race concludes.

 

Q: What’s the course like?

A:  Runners will run two loops for the 5k on the road inside of William Land Park! The Start/Finish line is located by the Village Green at the corner of Freeport Blvd and Sutterville Rd.

 

Q:What time should participants arrive?

A: Registration opens at 7:30 and the race begins at 8:30. At registration you can pick up your bib and shirt!

 

About FosterHope Sacramento


Since 1985 FosterHope Sacramento has been providing services for El Dorado, Placer, San Joaquin, Yolo and Sacramento Counties. For 40 years FosterHope has directly impacted the lives of youth and families within the greater Sacramento region providing care, community and support. As a California licensed, 501(c)(3) nonprofit Foster Family Agency (FFA), our Care Homes are located from Stockton to Shingle Springs and from Tahoe City to Sacramento.
Federal Tax ID: 68-0073413

name: Run Your Heart Out – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1:00-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 10m and half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located at the Belmont Pier. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, gatorade, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag


Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All runners receive a finishing medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent the day after the race. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Run/Walk for WeSPARK 5K/10K & Kids FUN RUN
description:
PRE-REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED. DAY OF RACE WALK-UPS WELCOME!

Walk-Up Registrations will be $45 + Fees  

If you've Pre-Registered, please check your email for Race Day Details.

 

 

RACE LOCATION:
Woodley Park Section 1, Lake Balboa
6076 Woodley Ave.
Encino, CA 91316

 

Lace up your running shoes! Our 15th Annual Run/Walk for WeSPARK 5K/10K & Kids FUN RUN is rescheduled for Sunday, February 23rd at Woodley Park, Lake Balboa. Grab your family and friends and let's get moving for WeSPARK Cancer Support Center. There is something for all athletic abilities!

 

5K and 10K races offer their own Chip-timed Courses around scenic Lake Balboa. Each course is fast, flat and great for the experienced runner or the casual walker. Dogs (on leash) are welcome, too - register your dog and they get their own t-shirt!  Strollers are accessible on both courses. Bring the kids along for the Kids Fun Run - a short run in the Woodley Park area.

 

Join us for a fun-filled, family-friendly day!

  • 5K & 10K courses – Fast, Flat & Chip-timed
  • Commemorative T-shirt & Finisher Medal for all Registrants
  • Age Division Awards – 1st, 2nd & 3rd Place Awards in all Age Groups
  • Kids Fun Run (Ages 3-11)
  • Lively Vendor Expo Filled with Community Partners
  • Special Performances
  • Raffle Prizes
  • Great Music

Packet Pick-Up Begins @ 7:30am

Race Begins @ 9:00am

 

All proceeds benefit WeSPARK Cancer Support Center! www.wespark.org

 

Rain or Shine!

 

SPECIAL RAFFLE NOW AVAILABLE! 

Click HERE to purchase Raffle Tickets and Preview the Exciting Prizes.

Random drawing will be held on Monday, February 24th at 12pm PST.

name: Runnin' To The Rig
description:
Embrace the BHS Legacy and Join us for our 2nd Runnin' To The Rig 5k Run/Walk!

Saturday, February 21st - Shot Gun Start at 8:30am and Check-in at 7:30am

Runners Start on Morrow Field / Walkers Start on Griffith Field Stadium / Embrace the Legacy Tour meets at the Water Tower near the concessions stand at Griffith Field.

Day of Race Registration 7am - 8am at Check-In Desk at Table on Morrow Field.  Cost is $40/pp

We invite you to participate with us in this FUNdraising endeavor to build community and raise funds. Our 5k course is designed as a nostalgic run/walk throughout our historic campus ending near the famous football tunnel in Griffith Stadium.   Our 2K walk will meander around campus and even through some of the buildings.  The Walk will start after the Run.  Medals given to all finishers!          

Race T-shirts can be purchased during registration for an extra fee if you pre-register  by January 30th.  We can not guarantee sizes if you register after January 30th. 

Plan to hang around after the race for pictures and selfies on historic Griffith Field. 

Don't wait, come join the fun! We are grateful for your support of Bakersfield High School. Go Blue! Once a Driller, Always a Driller!

 

Bib & T-shirt Pickup

You can pick up your race packet and t-shirt at the stadium parking lot near Griffith Stadium.

Fri. Feb. 20,  3:30-6 pm
Sat. Feb. 21,  7-8 am

name: Running Is For The Birds - 5K, 10K, Kids Run - Earth Day Celebration
description:
Amigos De Bolsa Chica, in conjunction with Bolsa Chica State Beach is hosting a run/walk/beach cleanup for Earth Day! 

Run for the Birds, Run for the Planet, Run for Earth Day at a local 5k/10k near you!

Run and walk along the beach on a flat, fast, and paved course.  The event is at Bolsa Chica State Beach, Saturday April 25, 2026 -- all races start at 8:00 AM, but be there beforehand for FREE BEACH PARKING! 

You can register to run/walk a Plover Dash 5K, Brown Pelican 10K, Fuzzy Feathers fun run (for the kiddos), 5K Plogging (picking up litter while jogging), 10K Plogging, or a Beach Clean Up with State Beach!

Every participant in the Plover Dash 5K, Brown Pelican 10K, and Plogging events will receive:

🏅 Custom Commemorative Medal – designed exclusively for this event.
👕 Limited-Edition Race Shirt – created by a local artist, featuring a different Bolsa Chica bird each year (a collectible piece of art you’ll want to wear proudly).
📸 Free Race Day Photos – downloadable and shareable, NO hidden costs.
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards – recognition for top finishers in multiple categories.
⏱️ New & Professional Chip Timing – results automatically synced to Athlinks.
🎪 Finish Line Festival – with vendors, product samples, music, and HB community vibes.

🌴 Race Day Details
📍 Location: Lot 25, Bolsa Chica State Beach
🕖 Check-in: 7:00 AM - 
🏁 5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
🦜 Kids Fun Run: 9:00 AM
✅ FREE Beach Parking — but we encourage you to go green!
🚲 Bike to the event and enjoy our safe-keeping Bike Valet just steps from the start line.
🎒 Gear Check Available – store your personal items securely while you run.

**Fuzzy Feathers Kids Run participants receive commemorative medals & special prizes for their participation**

Check in begins at 7am in lot 25 at Bolsa Chica State Beach.  5K and 10K begin at 8am.  Kids fun run starts at 9am.  

✨ Bonus Highlights

  • Environmental Impact – proceeds go to educational programs for children, schools, & the public; optional plogging categories combine running with cleanup.

  • Community Connection – a welcoming event for runners, walkers, families, and volunteers!

Proceeds help the Amigos de Bolsa Chica's (a 501c3 non-profit established in 1976) efforts to offer environmental leadership roles to all by providing community-based education programs centered on the Bolsa Chica that create greater awareness of coastal California's threatened biodiversity. 

There is a family friendly expo before and after the race, showing what the Amigos de Bolsa Chica is all about.  Look at Bolsa Chica Ecological Reserve water samples through microscopes, learn about the wetlands and the birds that visit there, and explore what we can do to protect the environment and the wildlife of the wetlands.

Join us this Earth Day — and make your miles matter. 🌎💚

name: Running of the Elves 5k
description:
On Saturday, December 6th at 8am, the Yuba-Sutter Training Zone will host the 2025 Running of the Elves 5k/10k. All proceeds from this race will benefit the Jayden's Shoes.

COURSE: Starts in front of Yuba Sutter Training Zone (830 J St, Marysville, CA).

Online registration will close Friday, December 5th at midnight. If you miss online registration, you will be able to register day of, register early to save!!

Race bibs can be picked up on Friday, December 5th at the Training Zone after 12:00pm or on race day.

RACE DAY REGISTRATION: Begins at 7:15 am at Training Zone in Marysville, 10k will start at 8am and 5k to follow at 8:05am.

AWARDS: Medals will be presented to the first 3 male and female finishers in each division: 9 & under, 10-14, 15-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60 & older. 

Jayden’s Shoes - Jayden A. Bird Foundation was formed in honor of the life of Jayden A. Bird, who was tragically killed in a car accident at the age of eighteen in September 2023. Jayden touched and inspired so many people. He had a gentle soul and a loving heart. Jayden had a natural gift for making everyone feel accepted, loved, and part of a group. Jayden expressed before passing away that he wanted youth athletes who were in need to have the athletic shoes they wanted and needed to play sports. We aim to provide that for them to honor Jayden’s desire and legacy.

name: Running of the Turkeys 5K & 10K Trail Run
description:
Join Us for the Annual Running of the Turkeys 5K/10K Trail Run!🦃

Kick off your Thanksgiving morning with our annual Running of the Turkeys trail run! Enjoy rolling hills and wide dirt trails, featuring a stunning waterfall view at the halfway point. We can’t think of a better way to burn a few calories before indulging in pumpkin pie. Bring your family and friends and join us for a great time, we can’t wait to see you out there!

Event Details:
📍 Location: Torrey Hills Neighborhood Park, 4300 Calle Mejillones, San Diego, CA 92130
🕢 Pre-Race Briefing: 7:40 AM (we’ll then walk about ½ mile to the start/finish area)

This is a NO FRILLS fun run - no timing, no parking fees, no stress, just a relaxed morning on the trails with great people! Please note this is a cupless event, so bring your own water if you’d like hydration on the course.

Entry & Charity Info:
There’s no official entry fee, but we kindly ask for a minimum $20 per person donation to support our partner charity, Operation Rebound, a division of the Challenged Athletes Foundation (CAF). This incredible organization helps military, first responders, and veterans with permanent physical injuries get back into sports. 

Not in San Diego? Join Us Virtually!
If you can’t attend in person, we’d love to have you participate wherever you are! Just share your run photos using #gutcheckfitness and #runningoftheturkeys to celebrate with our community.

Happy Thanksgiving and happy trails!

We can’t think of a better way to burn a few calories before indulging in pumpkin pie. Bring your family and friends and join us for a great time, we can’t wait to see you out there!

Event Details:
📍 Location: Torrey Hills Neighborhood Park, 4300 Calle Mejillones, San Diego, CA 92130

There’s no official entry fee, but we kindly ask for a minimum $20 per person donation to support our partner charity, Operation Rebound, a division of the Challenged Athletes Foundation (CAF). This incredible organization helps military, first responders, and veterans with permanent physical injuries get back into sports. 

Not in San Diego? Join Us Virtually!
If you can’t attend in person, we’d love to have you participate wherever you are! Just share your run photos using #gutcheckfitness and #runningoftheturkeys to celebrate with our community.

Happy Thanksgiving and happy trails!

name: Ruth McKenzie Preserve Half Marathon | 10k | 5k | Kids Race
description:
The Ruth McKenzie Table Mountain Preserve (2960 acres) is located between Friant and Prather, on the north side of Auberry Road. The main gate is 3.3 miles uphill from the intersection of Auberry Road and Millerton Road.

The McKenzie Preserve was acquired in trust from The Nature Conservancy in 1998. The property had previously been placed in a trust by its owner, Ruth Bea McKenzie, who wanted it to remain in ranching and open space after her death.The McKenzie Preserve is primarily grassland and oak woodland that slopes upward toward the basalt lava table lands that give the preserve its name.

The preserve includes a significant portion of one of the flat-topped tables that are visible from the road. In spring, rain water collects in the table’s low spots, forming vernal pools. Since the basalt is impermeable, these pools hold water for several weeks or months until it eventually evaporates. The pools provide habitat for rare plants and crustaceans that “come to life” in the presence of the water. When the pools dry up in late spring, these crustaceans become seeds or cysts in order to survive the rest of the year. On the far side of the table formations, out of sight of Auberry Road, the land slopes steeply down to the San Joaquin River. These north-facing slopes sustain an excellent mix of pine forest and chaparral. The preserve also includes a 47-acre parcel along the creek on the south side.

name: Ryan's Ranch Run
description:
Ryan’s Ranch Run is a community-driven 5K, 10K, and Kids Mile hosted at the breathtaking Thousand Hills Ranch in Pismo Beach—Ryan Teixeira’s family ranch and the heart of his legacy. This unique event blends scenic running routes with a meaningful mission, raising funds for Central Coast Athletics Foundation (CCAF) and 17 Strong, an organization founded in Ryan’s honor to provide Victory Trips to young adults battling life-threatening illness.

Runners and walkers of all ages take on a mixed-terrain course with rolling hills and the spirit of community all around. Race day begins with the inspiring 17 Strong Victory Lap, followed by the Kids Mile and the 5K/10K races. After crossing the finish line, participants enjoy a lively festival with live music, local vendors, delicious food, raffle prizes, and family-friendly fun.

Ryan’s Ranch Run isn’t just a race—it’s a celebration of resilience, community, and giving back. Each step supports two impactful nonprofits and helps continue Ryan’s legacy of strength, joy, and living life to the fullest.

name: San Clemente Santa Run - 5K and Fun Run (Sponsored by Lily's Lighthouse)
description:
Join us for the 4th Annual, Lily's Lighthouse San Clemente Santa Run!  This is a rain or shine event!

In addition to the "Fun Run," we are delighted this year to be including a 5K, with prizes for 1st/2nd/3rd place for Men's (18+), Women's (18+), and Kids (under 18), as well as prizes for best outfit (Men's, Women's and Kids)!!!

Get ready to dash along the iconic scenic beach trail of San Clemente with Santa and his helpers!  The race will take place on Saturday, December 6th, 2025, with the starting line at the Pier Bowl in San Clemente (i.e., at the intersection of San Clemente Pier and the beach).  The race will go down to San Clemente State Beach along the beach path and then circle back and finish near the Pier Bowl.   

After the race, gather your merry elves and join the stroll or catch the trolly to the Awards Ceremony, After Party and Fundraiser at Krazy Kooters for a festive evening filled with fun, food, and community cheer because every registration comes with free admission, dinner, functional mushroom supplements (for the first 200 runners), a Santa Hat and a raffle ticket to win a premium set of premium Audeze Maxwell gaming headphones (retail value of $300).

Schedule:

2:30 p.m.: Santa gathering

3:00 p.m.: Beach Trail Run begins

4:30 p.m.: Run concludes & Santa’s stroll to Krazy Kooters for the Awards Ceremony, After Party and Fundraiser!  Event highlights include silent auction (featuring surfboards from San Clement's own T. Patterson and Brophy Surf Art, local breweries, Audeze headphones, and more) and Live Entertainment by BADLUCK BAND & DJ Stevie T, keeping the grooves going into the night!

Fundraising & Impact:  Your participation helps fund NEXT Research Study, bringing us closer to a cure for epilepsy. Did you know? 90% of participants in our recent mushroom study reported a significant impact on their seizures. Together, we can make a difference!

About Lily’s Lighthouse:  Based in San Clemente, CA, Lily’s Lighthouse is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to transforming lives through research and support for children living with epilepsy. Our mission bridges traditional and innovative treatments to improve health and wellbeing for all affected by epilepsy.  

We'd like to thank our gold level sponsors - Krazy Kooters, Sancho's Tacos and Califino Tequila!!!

For more information, sponsorship opportunities, or donations: Email us at: info@lilyslighthouse.org

Together, let’s shine a light on epilepsy.
